He calls for improving schools, reforming Social Security and Medicare, reducing taxes, strengthening defenses, confronting weapons of mass destruction, aiding those in poverty, honoring faith and charity groups, and promoting personal responsibility. He urges citizens to serve their communities and renew the nation’s commitment to dignity, justice, generosity, and service to one another.

The GHCB is a 4 KB decrypted/shared page used for communication between an SEV-ES or SEV-SNP guest and the hypervisor. Its layout mirrors the SEV-ES VMCB save state area where useful, but only required fields are exposed during VMGEXIT to limit guest state disclosure. Version 2 adds SEV-SNP support, hypervisor feature advertisement, XSS MSR reporting for CPUID 0xd, restricted APIC emulation, and requirements for shared areas referenced by SW_SCRATCH. Later revisions add updates for 64-bit guest request sequence numbers, VLEK GUID support, improved error reporting, APIC ID list retrieval, multi-VMPL support, page state change notification, SEV-SNP EFI blob documentation, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, unsupported MSR protocol behavior, and GUID formats.

Hypervisor features are advertised through a 52-bit FEATURES bitmap returned via the GHCB MSR protocol before a GHCB page is established. The guest specifies the GHCB guest physical address, which must be 4 KB aligned and made shared. MSR 0xc001_0130 is used for GHCB communication and must not be intercepted by the hypervisor. SEV-SNP guests must register a GHCB GPA before first use; registration may use a hypervisor-preferred GPA, and unregistering is supported when advertised.

The GHCB MSR protocol supports SEV information negotiation, CPUID requests, AP reset hold, GHCB GPA registration, page state changes, VMPL switching, feature discovery, and guest termination requests. GHCB negotiation examples describe how the hypervisor supplies protocol version ranges and the SEV encryption bit, while the guest configures page tables, establishes #VC handling, allocates a shared GHCB page, and registers it when required.

Non-Automatic Exit events generate #VC exceptions for SEV-ES guests. The guest populates GHCB fields, marks valid fields in VALID_BITMAP, issues VMGEXIT, and processes hypervisor results. Supported NAE handling includes I/O, MSR access, VMMCALL, MMIO, page state changes, SNP guest requests, extended guest requests, AP creation, #HV doorbell pages, IPI and timer support under Restricted Injection, APIC ID lists, VMPL switching, SEV-TIO guest requests, Secure AVIC backing page registration, termination requests, and unsupported exit reporting.

The passage also defines SEV-SNP secrets page guest-reserved data, the EFI SEV-SNP Confidential Computing Blob configuration table, SMP and AP boot handling, NMI completion handling, debug register virtualization behavior, lack of SMM and nested virtualization support, and #HV doorbell page rules for restricted interrupt notification, interrupt acknowledgement, EOI optimization, and host/guest behavior.

In July 2020, the NHL and NHL Players’ Association negotiated both a return-to-play plan for the COVID-interrupted 2019-20 season and an extension of the collective bargaining agreement through 2025-26. The prior 2013 CBA, reached after a 113-day lockout, set player compensation at 50% of league revenue, with payments to players or clawbacks by owners depending on actual revenue and compensation. This made the measurement of league revenue and player compensation central to negotiations. For the 2020 talks, players were represented by Emilie Castonguay and owners by Commissioner Gary Bettman. Potential negotiation issues included treatment of ticket sales, broadcasting rights, concessions, player salaries, signing bonuses, deferred salary, and contract buyouts. Both sides understood that revenue and compensation calculations affected revenue sharing, while extreme positions risked reopening the 50/50 split and possible lost games.

The passage highlights Green Monday laptop deals available before the holidays, noting that offers may change and shipping time is limited. Featured deals include the HP Envy x360 for $700 with a Core i5, 8GB RAM, 1TB hard drive, and 1080p touchscreen; a 14-inch Razer Blade gaming laptop for $1,600 with Core i7, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD, and GTX 1060; an HP Laptop 14t for $190 with Celeron processor, 4GB RAM, and 32GB storage; a Dell I3567-3964BLK at Staples for $380 with Core i3, 8GB RAM, and 2TB hard drive; and a Lenovo 14-inch touchscreen 2-in-1 at Best Buy for $330 with Pentium processor, 4GB RAM, and 500GB hard drive.

James Johnson was convicted of murdering J. A. Johnson and sentenced to life imprisonment. The court affirmed the denial of his motion for a new trial. It held that jurors from a prior trial were not disqualified merely because they had previously been stricken or possibly excused, absent specific objections. Evidence about Johnson’s statements concerning his father’s life insurance, bank money, and papers was admissible as relevant to possible motive. The court also found no error in charging that Johnson admitted the killing was murder but denied being the perpetrator, because his own statement and the evidence supported that characterization. The remaining grounds showed no error, and the verdict was supported by the evidence.

The Ninth Circuit granted Harnek Singh’s petition in part and remanded for the BIA to consider his adverse-credibility challenge and eligibility for asylum and withholding of removal. It granted Baljinder Kaur’s petition and remanded for full consideration of her claims, including due process, accepting her testimony as credible.

An NPR/Marist poll finds 30 percent of Americans earn extra pay in addition to full-time jobs. Emily Doherty, 28, works at a museum and takes evening and weekend living-history performance jobs to cover expenses and a $500 monthly student loan payment, leaving little time for friends, family or rest. Student loan debt totals nearly $1.4 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Susan Lambert of the University of Chicago says second jobs can strain well-being and family life. Jon Jacobs, a full-time substance addiction therapist with student loans and two children, left bartending for Lyft because it offered more flexibility, though less money. Doherty says she seeks financial stability and is saving to visit her family in Maine after three years away.

Researchers have created the first hybrid embryos using frozen northern white rhino sperm and southern white rhino eggs, a step they say could help prevent the extinction of the northern white rhino, of which only two females remain. They plan to harvest eggs from Najin and Fatu, fertilize them with preserved sperm to create pure northern white rhino embryos, and implant them in southern white rhino surrogates, since the two females cannot carry offspring.

Scientists are also exploring a method to turn frozen skin cells from deceased rhinos into egg cells to preserve genetic diversity. Thomas Hildebrandt said they hope for a calf in about three years. The effort involves international collaboration, though some conservationists argue it is costly, uncertain, and distracts from protecting other endangered rhino species. Researchers are awaiting Kenyan approval to collect eggs from the two females, with concerns about possible health risks during the procedure.

The speaker said their team got away from its game after the second goal, became frustrated, and took bad penalties. They believe the goalie will bounce back, and said the team needed to return to its style after a good start and an overtime loss.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on July 19, 2018, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2018. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed under Section 18 of the Exchange Act.

The forwarded Texas Monthly article describes Enron’s rise from a troubled pipeline company into a dominant energy-trading firm under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. It credits Skilling with creating the Gas Bank model, expanding trading into gas, electricity, commodities, and broadband, and building an aggressive, high-pressure culture focused on rapid profits, recruitment of elite talent, and harsh performance rankings. The article says this culture also fostered internal competition, short-term thinking, and strained relationships with employees and customers. By 2001, Enron faced falling stock prices, criticism over California’s energy crisis, problems with its India power project, failed broadband ambitions, scrutiny of its accounting, and negative press. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, and Lay returned, promising a more focused and less harsh company.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting results from its February 26, 2020 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. Shareholders elected James Bell, Tim Cook, Al Gore, Andrea Jung, Art Levinson, Ron Sugar, and Sue Wagner as directors. They approved ratifying Ernst & Young LLP as Apple’s independent registered public accounting firm for 2020 and approved an advisory resolution on executive compensation. Shareholder proposals on proxy access amendments, sustainability and executive compensation, and freedom of expression policies were not approved. The report was signed February 27, 2020 by Katherine Adams, Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary.

This Foreign Relations volume documents the intellectual foundations of Reagan administration foreign policy rather than specific decisions or diplomatic exchanges. It uses selected public and internal records from 1981–1988 to illustrate major themes and policymakers’ perspectives, including efforts to reset U.S. foreign policy, promote U.S. values, pursue activist bipartisan policy, and shape U.S.-Soviet relations around restraint and reciprocity. Editorial notes explain sources, classifications, related documents, events, and supplemental accounts. The Advisory Committee oversees the series’ compilation and declassification process. The Department of State’s declassification review, conducted from 2018 to 2022, withheld no documents, made no paragraph-level excisions, and made minor excisions in three documents.

This study examined whether serum cardiac troponin T (cTnT) is associated with respiratory dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Two hospital-based cohorts were analyzed: a Bonn discovery cohort and an Essen validation cohort. Patients had ALSFRSr scores, serum cTnT measurements, and, for subsets, pulmonary function testing and serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) data.

Serum cTnT was elevated in 65% of the Bonn cohort and 47% of the Essen cohort. In the discovery cohort, cTnT correlated negatively with total ALSFRSr and its respiratory domain, and with pulmonary function parameters including FVC, SVC, FEV1, and PEF. Multiple regression confirmed associations with FVC, SVC, and FEV1 after adjustment for sex, onset subtype, BMI, and age. Key associations, including with the ALSFRSr respiratory domain and SVC, were supported in the validation cohort. Serum NfL correlated with total ALSFRSr but not with respiratory function measures.

ROC analyses showed serum cTnT had diagnostic utility for detecting clinically relevant declines in SVC, FVC, and PEF, with optimal cutoffs similar to established cardiac thresholds. The authors conclude that serum cTnT may serve as an ALS biomarker reflecting respiratory capacity and complementing neurofilament measurements. Limitations include the observational design, small validation cohort, and complexity of pulmonary function testing in ALS.

Ryshonda Harper Beechem became Pelahatchie, Mississippi’s first black mayor in June 2017, winning by 12 votes in a town of about 1,300. Since taking office, she has faced conflict with the Board of Aldermen, which has changed rules, proposed hires without consulting her, overridden vetoes, and cut her part-time mayoral salary by 75 percent to $250 per month, equal to aldermen pay. The board cited budget cuts, while Beechem, an accountant, said the cuts were unnecessary and inconsistent with the mayor’s responsibilities. She vetoed the pay cut, citing no confidence in the board amid a state auditor investigation into alleged misappropriation of town funds. The town also saw clerk resignations and disputes over appointments. Beechem and the board have developed a publicly hostile relationship, with residents debating the conflict online, including claims of racism and criticism of the mayor.

The Cleveland Indians beat the Minnesota Twins 3-1. Danny Salazar allowed one run in six innings, struck out seven, and earned the win after improving following a difficult first two innings. Yan Gomes reached base three times and scored the tying run. Michael Brantley drove in the first run and added a solo home run, while Edwin Encarnacion delivered the go-ahead hit. The Indians bullpen threw three scoreless innings, and Bryan Shaw recorded his 86th hold with the team. The teams were set to play again the next night, with Josh Tomlin facing Phil Hughes.

This study prospectively examined whether the COVID-19 pandemic affected health-related quality of life (HRQOL) among head and neck cancer (HNC) survivors and whether specific subgroups were differently affected. Data came from the NET-QUBIC cohort, which included HNC patients treated with curative intent in the Netherlands. The analysis included 318 survivors who completed patient-reported outcome measures at 36 months after treatment: 199 before the pandemic and 119 during the pandemic. Measures included disease- and tumor-specific HRQOL, physical activity, distress, anxiety, depression, fear of cancer recurrence, and loneliness.

Overall, there were no statistically significant differences in changes in patient-reported outcomes between 24 and 36 months after treatment between survivors assessed before COVID-19 and those assessed during COVID-19. However, subgroup analyses found differing effects for some outcomes. Negative effects during COVID-19 were observed among females for physical activity, survivors treated with multimodality treatment for appetite loss, survivors with comorbidity for swallowing problems, and survivors with a lifetime major depressive disorder for fear of recurrence. Positive effects were observed among survivors living alone for painkiller use, survivors with disease progression for financial problems, and survivors with higher BMI for emotional loneliness.

The study concluded that the overall course of HRQOL in HNC survivors between 24 and 36 months after treatment was not affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, but some HRQOL domains or symptoms changed in specific subgroups. The authors suggested personalized supportive care programs combining regular care, eHealth, and peer support.

Twitter shares fell 9% after the company reported fourth-quarter revenue of $717 million, below Wall Street’s $740.1 million estimate, and issued first-quarter guidance far under expectations. Earnings were 16 cents per share. Monthly active users rose to 319 million, while advertising revenue slipped to $638 million.

Text2MBL is a framework that translates parametric textual descriptions into BIM-based modular building layouts using action-level code sequences. It addresses challenges in modular layout design, user-inclusive mass customization, and direct BIM generation from text. The system structures layouts into Modules, Units, Rooms, and Utils, and was implemented in Autodesk Revit using the C# API. It represents design generation as sequential actions such as module creation, splitting, merging, unit initialization, room assignment, and element placement. The authors define modular layouts through geometric, semantic, adjacency, connectivity, conjoint, and hierarchical containment relationships. A dataset of 198 modular building designs was curated from official sources, with executable BIM code and two textual descriptions per design, using both named and positional coding styles. Large language models from the Qwen2.5 family were fine-tuned and evaluated for executable validity, semantic fidelity, and geometric consistency.

Women make up 11 percent of the cybersecurity workforce, despite higher education levels, with discrimination, negative feedback in male-dominated settings and lack of educator support cited as contributing factors. Glance Pay executives Angela Griffin and Paola Ashton emphasize inclusive leadership and diversity as drivers of company culture, growth, innovation and U.S. expansion. The passage argues that gender diversity improves decision-making and better reflects customer needs, while noting there is no evidence of an ability gap in technology. It encourages organizations to support women through peer networks, anti-bias efforts and programs such as Girls in Tech, Women Who Code and the Anita Borg Institute. Glance Technologies operates Glance Pay, a mobile payment platform with marketing, rewards, anti-fraud technology and planned cryptocurrency integration.

The passage explains common football pass routes and how route trees help coaches organize and teach them, though route trees vary by team and are less commonly used to call plays today. It describes short routes such as hitch, slant, quick out, stick, flat, whip, and option routes, emphasizing timing, spacing, defensive reactions, and quick throws. It also covers vertical and intermediate routes including go, seam, corner, post, post-corner, square out, dig, curl, comeback, drag, and shallow cross, noting their depths, break points, coverage uses, and reliance on quarterback-receiver timing.

Paralyzed Veterans of America thanked Deputy Secretary Tom Bowman for his service and wished him well in retirement. The organization said it looks forward to working with Acting Secretary Peter O’Rourke and prioritizing implementation of the VA MISSION Act, while noting concern over continued VA leadership changes.

A Markov model using published Brazilian data assessed Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection screening and tuberculosis preventive treatment for formerly incarcerated individuals. Compared with no screening, all preventive treatment strategies were cost-effective. A tuberculin skin test plus 3 months of isoniazid and rifapentine cost $242 per DALY averted and was estimated to prevent 31 lifetime TB cases and 4.1 TB deaths per 1,000 treated individuals. Benefits and cost-effectiveness were greater among younger people, those incarcerated longer, and those screened soon after release, but remained favorable across all subgroups. The study concludes that Mtb infection screening and preventive treatment could be an impactful, cost-effective intervention for formerly incarcerated individuals in Brazil.

The speaker describes the Stanley Cup loss as the toughest of his career, saying the team was one shot or goal away despite working hard and never quitting. He says the game was tight, the opponent deserved credit, and Khabibulin made key saves. Injuries were not an excuse, though Donovan was missed. He is proud of the season and young defense, but says the pain will linger and motivate the team.

Gennaro Gattuso urged AC Milan to stay grounded after an improved run, saying they must remain hard-working and “ugly” rather than think about Champions League qualification. Milan are seventh in Serie A and unbeaten in six matches. Gattuso praised team unity and Patrick Cutrone’s attitude, and warned Udinese would be a difficult opponent.

Joshua Thomas Teeter, 20, of Mason City, faces multiple charges in Cerro Gordo and Worth counties, including theft, burglary, and conspiracy. Authorities accuse him and others of stealing snowmobiles, property from trailers, and a safe. He is jailed on $20,000 bail.

This passage introduces the 2018 ebook edition of Foreign Relations of the United States: Diplomatic Papers, 1945, Volume I, describing its portability, full-text search, offline access, and fidelity to the printed edition. It recommends citing document numbers rather than page numbers. The preface identifies the officials and staff who prepared, compiled, and edited the volume. It also states the Foreign Relations compilation principles under Department of State Regulation 1350, emphasizing comprehensive documentation, historical objectivity, transparency about deletions, and avoidance of omissions that conceal policy defects. An introductory note explains that American Foreign Policy became a companion series in 1950, while Foreign Relations provides selected public documents for 1945–1949.

The Supreme Court will hear oral arguments in January 2026 on the Trump administration’s request to allow President Trump to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, but deferred action on the request, leaving a lower-court order keeping Cook in office in place. Trump sought to remove Cook over mortgage fraud allegations, which she denies, arguing they constituted “cause” under federal law. U.S. District Judge Jia Cobb ruled Cook was likely to succeed in challenging the removal because the alleged conduct occurred before she took office and because she was entitled to notice and a hearing. The D.C. Circuit declined to pause Cobb’s order, prompting the administration to seek Supreme Court intervention. Cook argued the allegations were unproven and that Trump’s interpretation of “for cause” would undermine Federal Reserve independence.

The passage describes embodiments for wireless communication systems, particularly access control and operation of wireless devices, including reduced-capability devices, and base stations. It outlines mobile network architectures including CN, RAN, 5G-CN, NG-RAN, gNBs, ng-eNBs, UEs, AMF, and UPF, along with interfaces such as Uu, NG, and Xn. It summarizes NR user-plane and control-plane protocol stacks, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, SDAP, RRC, and NAS layers, and their functions.

The passage also describes NR channel mappings, physical-layer processing, RRC states and transitions, OFDM numerologies, slots, subframes, frames, resource grids, bandwidth parts, carrier aggregation, PUCCH groups, random access procedures, synchronization signals, SSBs, CSI-RS, SRS, beamforming, beam management, QCL, DM-RS, PT-RS, and timers. It further describes example wireless device and base station components, including antennas, RF front ends, data processing systems, memory, processors, and GPS modules, as well as configuration through RRC messages and other control signaling.

This study investigates how collagen fiber continuity and tortuosity affect the mechanical response of collagenous arterial tissue with local wall thickness variations. Using multiphoton microscopy examples and 3D representative volume element finite element models, the authors compared two fiber architectures: abrupt fiber termination and continuous fibers spanning thickness gradients. Under uniaxial loading, abrupt fiber termination produced large stretch and stress disparities between thin and thick regions, while continuous fibers substantially reduced these differences through load transfer and increased local fiber density in thinner regions. Fiber tortuosity delayed collagen recruitment, causing geometry-dominated behavior before fiber engagement and fiber-dominated behavior afterward. The study concludes that collagen microstructure, not geometry alone, strongly governs local mechanics, and accurate fiber representation is important for biomechanical modeling and rupture risk prediction.

LG’s SJ9500 Super UHD TV is its latest premium 4K LCD model, using Nano Cell quantum dot film for more accurate colors, deeper blacks, and wider viewing angles. It supports HDR10, Dolby Vision, Advanced HDR, Active HDR scene optimization, and HDR Effect for simulating HDR from standard content. The TV has a thin, nearly edge-to-edge metal design and is 6.9 mm at its thinnest point. LG is also introducing the SJ8500 and SJ8000 with similar display technology and features. Pricing and release details have not been announced.

The passage outlines SAP rules for conservative handling of missing or incomplete dates for adverse events and concomitant medications, derivation formulas for durations, unit conversions, BMI, and change from baseline. It specifies SAS programming QC requirements covering program structure, log review, output review, dataset validation, data verification, figures, listings, and documentation. It also lists planned tables, figures, and listings for ICH E3 sections 14 and 16.2, including patient disposition, demographics, efficacy analyses of plasma glucose recovery, adverse events, safety assessments, ECG, labs, vital signs, immunogenicity, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic summaries, and related listings. Several mock table notes define analysis populations, sorting, denominators, statistical methods, censoring rules, and programming instructions.
Figures show perspective and side views of a carabiner embodiment.

The speaker says playing at home feels more comfortable than on the road, though preparation is similar. They expect an intense game against a strong team and plan to focus one period at a time. The team’s depth, positive mindset, and experience from last year help them stay composed. Memories of Vladi, Sergei, and last year’s accident remain important and motivate the team, though the speaker tries to manage emotions and focus on playing. They emphasize wanting to win, avoid disrupting the team routine, stay in shape, and fit into the team’s success.

Enerfax Daily’s February 26, 2002 issue lists North American natural gas and power prices, futures, NYMEX volumes, option volatility, and financial market indicators. March NYMEX natural gas futures fell 6% to $2.307/MMBtu, with April down to $2.348, while next-day Henry Hub gas was unchanged at $2.40. California plans to ask FERC to void 32 long-term power contracts valued at $43 billion, alleging unjust prices and terms. Articles also report on UtiliCorp’s mark-to-market accounting exposure, possible departures of Arthur Andersen partners amid Enron-related lawsuits, a videotape raising questions about Jeffrey Skilling’s Enron testimony, Williams Communications considering bankruptcy, Centrica’s planned purchase of NewPower Holdings, Calpine’s stable S&P rating, and Dynegy’s filing to sell shares in Dynegy Energy Partners. The issue also includes energy bulletins, open season and conference notices, and multiple advertisements for energy risk, storage, software, and consulting services.

Asteroid 2025 TF, measuring about 1 to 3 meters wide, passed over Antarctica on October 1 at 00:47:26 UTC, coming within 428 ± 7 km of Earth’s surface, near the altitude of the International Space Station. It was detected by the Catalina Sky Survey hours after its flyby and posed no danger. ESA astronomers later used the Las Cumbres Observatory telescope in Australia to refine its trajectory with high precision. The passage explains that small asteroids like 2025 TF usually burn up in the atmosphere, while larger objects can cause local, regional, or global damage. It also highlights the role of observatory networks and planetary defense programs in detecting, tracking, and modeling near-Earth objects.

The PENTAD Timing Model by Nelson Freeburg is an active US stock market timing strategy that generates buy/sell signals using four stock indices and one advance/decline line on a weekly timeframe. It uses moving average envelopes and moving average slope indicators. The model operates as a voting system: entry requires unanimous “yes” signals, while two or more “against” votes trigger an exit. The passage also describes Freeburg’s background and notes that the model is backtested on historical price data.

Reports in Seoul claimed that the Tong Hâk were gathering in large numbers, intended to march on the city, and sought to expel foreigners, but officials and interpreters could not substantiate the rumors. Foreign representatives considered retaining British and German gunboats at Chemulpo, but no clear danger was confirmed and the ships departed. About forty Tong Hâk members appeared at the palace gate with a petition seeking redress for the condemnation of their founder, Ch’e Cheng-woo, recognition of their religion, and possibly intervention against foreigners and Christianity. Their leader, Pak Siung-ho, described the faith as founded in 1859, centered on worship of one God, ancestor sacrifice, social duties, and “reverence for God and love for man,” while denying hostility to foreigners or popular claims of conjuring practices. The passage notes that the movement may include sincere believers, opportunists, opponents of Roman Catholics, and others motivated by resentment over perceived protections enjoyed by Catholics.

The passage describes a patent application related to non-invasive transcutaneous nerve stimulation, particularly facial nerve stimulation to artificially elicit eye blinking in humans with acute facial paralysis. It provides background on facial nerve anatomy, facial expression control, taste and sensory functions, facial nerve paralysis, and Bell’s palsy, including symptoms such as one-sided facial weakness, drooping eyelid, loss of taste, hyperacusis, and reduced tear secretion.

It explains that blinking spreads tears, removes irritants, protects the eye, and depends mainly on the orbicularis oculi and levator palpebrae superioris muscles, with blink types including spontaneous, reflex, and voluntary. Dry eye syndrome is described as a condition involving inadequate tear production or excessive evaporation, with symptoms including irritation, redness, burning, blurred vision, and possible corneal damage if untreated.

The passage also reviews technologies relevant to the disclosed system, including TENS, EMS, skin electrodes, electronic skin electrodes, EEG electrodes, implantable electrodes, and EEG measurement. It further describes supporting communication and computing technologies such as the Internet, TCP/IP, wireless networks, ISM bands, ZigBee, Z-Wave, WWAN, WLAN, BAN, Bluetooth, Bluetooth Low Energy, wireless mesh networks, cellular networks, NFC, random number generation, smartphones, instant messaging, SMS, MMS, Facebook Messenger, Twitter, and WhatsApp.

The Mortgage Collaborative announced a partnership with Strategic Compliance Partners, adding the compliance solutions provider to its preferred partner network. SCP offers compliance management solutions for mortgage banks, warehouse banks, brokers, and other financial institutions, combining legal insight, technology, attorneys, and compliance specialists. The partnership is intended to support The Mortgage Collaborative’s lender members with regulatory compliance guidance. The Mortgage Collaborative’s network includes more than 110 lenders with over $190 billion in aggregate annual origination volume.

The Facebook-Cambridge Analytica scandal heightened public awareness of data surveillance, privacy settings, app permissions, and Facebook’s third-party data access practices. While unauthorized access and weak consent are important concerns, the passage argues that the deeper issue is personalized “choice architecture”: decision environments tailored to individuals using collected data to influence choices subconsciously. Unlike traditional choice architecture, which affects people broadly, personalized microtargeting targets individual traits and preferences, blurring persuasion and coercion and threatening autonomy. The passage notes that such methods are rising beyond Cambridge Analytica, citing examples involving Jigsaw and Facebook. Personalized choice architecture can be beneficial, such as encouraging healthy habits or increasing voter turnout, but if misused it can manipulate individuals and undermine democratic elections. The passage calls for systematic social, economic, technical, legal, and ethical solutions to prevent microtargeting from nullifying individual choice.

General Electric said CFO Jeff Bornstein, marketing chief Beth Comstock and international executive John Rice will leave as new CEO John Flannery reshapes leadership. Jamie Miller will become CFO on Nov. 1, while Pascal Schweitzer will serve as interim head of transportation. The changes come as Flannery reviews GE’s portfolio, cuts costs and faces pressure from activist investor Trian Fund Management. GE is expected to lower financial projections in November, when Flannery outlines turnaround plans. The company’s shares have fallen 23% this year.

Supervalu Inc (NYSE:SVU) shares fell 3.04% in the most recent session, closing at $14.36. Analysts polled by Thomson Reuters’ First Call have a 12-month mean price target of $25.75 based on 8 opinions, with targets ranging from $14 to $55. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 3 based on 5 recommendations, with 1 Buy, 1 Outperform, 7 Hold, 2 Underperform and 0 Sell ratings. Supervalu’s ATR-14 is 0.78, weekly volatility is 6.46%, monthly volatility is 5.36%, and RSI is 42.74. The company has a market capitalization of $558.46 million, 38.89 million shares outstanding, and traded 1.72 million shares versus a 1.47 million average.

A solar eclipse will cross the United States on Aug. 21, 2017. Areas within a roughly 70-mile-wide path of totality will experience total darkness, while the rest of the country will see a partial eclipse with 20% to 99% sun coverage. Totality reaches Oregon at 10:16 a.m. PT and exits the Atlantic coast at 2:49 p.m. ET, taking 1 hour and 33 minutes to cross the country.

During the eclipse, the sky will darken; in totality, stars may appear and temperatures will drop. Viewers may see Baily’s Beads and a diamond ring effect. NASA offers an interactive map showing timing and coverage by location. Proper eclipse glasses compliant with ISO 12312-2 are required except during the brief period of totality. NASA and other sites will livestream the event. The next solar eclipse is July 2, 2019, and the next over the United States is April 8, 2024.

A webinar on responsible sourcing in the cable value chain discusses rising cable demand from electrification, growing ESG requirements, supply chain and human rights commitments, and the role of standards. Panelists represent Rexel, KGHM, Copper Mark, and Nexans, with an opening question to Nexans on its responsible sourcing practices and challenges.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that it published a press release dated April 2, 2022, furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01 and attached as Exhibit 99.1. The report lists Tesla’s common stock on Nasdaq under TSLA and was signed by CFO Zachary J. Kirkhorn on April 4, 2022.

The passage outlines statistical analysis plan procedures for pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and safety data. Plasma dasiglucagon and GlucaGen are sampled pre-dose and up to 300 minutes post-dose, with defined timing windows, handling rules for below-LLOQ and missing values, and PK metrics determined by Synteract using laboratory data transfers. Plasma glucose is sampled pre-dose and up to 45 or 60 minutes post-dose, and the pharmacodynamic endpoint is AUE0-30min calculated in SAS.

Results will be presented through raw data listings, summary statistics by treatment group and time point, PK and PD metric summaries, and concentration-time figures on original and log scales where applicable. Safety analyses use the safety set and include insulin use before hypoglycemia induction, hypoglycemia induction procedures, trial medication administration, rescue glucose infusion, local tolerability, adverse events, laboratory tests, vital signs, physical examination listings, ECGs, and immunogenicity.

Treatment-emergent adverse events are defined as events after dosing or worsening pre-existing events. AEs are coded with MedDRA, summarized by treatment group, system organ class, preferred term, causal relationship, severity, seriousness, and special categories. Missing AE causality is treated as related if not clarified.

Laboratory, vital sign, ECG, and ADA results are summarized descriptively. QTcF thresholds and changes from baseline are tabulated. ADA incidence includes treatment-induced and treatment-boosted ADA among evaluable patients.

The SAP notes changes from the protocol, including rewording primary efficacy analysis and adding sensitivity/supportive analyses. Appendices specify formatting rules, derivation formulas, missing-date handling, SAS programming QC requirements, validation procedures, documentation, and planned tables, figures, and listings.

Alabama’s special Senate election pits Republican Roy Moore, accused of sexual misconduct with teenage girls decades ago, against Democrat Doug Jones, a former federal prosecutor known for prosecuting two Ku Klux Klansmen in the 1963 Birmingham church bombing. Democrats frame the race as a chance to reject Alabama’s troubled political history, while Republicans see it as a defense of conservative values and President Trump’s agenda. Moore denies the accusations and is backed by many conservatives and Trump, though some Republicans, including Sen. Richard Shelby, have refused to support him. The winner will fill Jeff Sessions’ former seat, with both parties watching for implications ahead of the 2018 midterms.

The US dollar consolidated gains after Treasury Secretary Mnuchin downplayed President Trump’s comments on dollar strength, saying they did not signal a currency war. The dollar rebounded against the yen, while the euro traded narrowly ahead of the French election. Sterling reversed lower amid speculation Prime Minister May could call a snap election, with UK yields slipping below 1%. Dollar-bloc currencies underperformed as Australian central bank minutes appeared dovish and iron ore prices fell. The US dollar also recovered against the Canadian dollar. US Treasury yields remained weak, and Mnuchin acknowledged healthcare reform obstacles had complicated tax reform, dampening expectations for stronger US growth and inflation.

The speaker says the young team plays better when loose, though nerves are expected before a big game. They identify neutral-zone turnovers, forechecking, adapting to deteriorating ice, and special teams as key factors against Dallas, described as strong defensively, in transition, and through the neutral zone. The nine-day layoff helped some players recover, including Miro and Dominik. Starting on the road is seen as beneficial because the team has played well away and may feel less pressure than at home.

The speaker discusses using Peca and possibly Primeau against Modano, while acknowledging matchup limits on the road. They credit Miro’s improved role and competitiveness, Stu’s persistence despite reduced ice time, strong penalty killing, and a key goaltending performance. They say early penalties, nerves, and the layoff contributed to being outplayed, but the team improved in the third period, stayed out of the box, got stronger, dumped pucks deep, pursued better, and found a way to win.

Williams & Connolly confirmed hackers accessed a small number of attorney email accounts through a zero-day attack but said there is no evidence confidential client data was taken from other IT systems. The firm said the hackers are believed to be affiliated with a nation-state actor linked to recent attacks on law firms and companies, and that it has blocked the threat with no current evidence of unauthorized network traffic.

The Dow fell 1.7% and the S&P 500 declined 1.3% as industrial, materials and technology shares dropped and the 10-year Treasury yield briefly reached 3%. The passage argues that central banks have shifted from buying $60 billion in global assets monthly to effectively selling $30 billion, reducing liquidity and pressuring asset prices. It says stocks, bonds and real estate lack safe havens after benefiting from stimulus, making buy-and-hold strategies ineffective. The author recommends rules-based trading strategies in volatile markets, citing a Sentiment Table Strategy that produced eight signals this year and about a 15% gain using Nasdaq 100 ETFs. The passage warns of a possible market crash as asset prices reprice without central bank support and says investors should either use proactive rules-based strategies or protect their portfolios.

German negotiator Schnurre said talks with Finland concerned extending and intensifying goods exchange and payment arrangements, covering raw materials and foreign trade, with Germany supplying Finland coal, iron, artificial wool and other goods. He said further payment regulation would follow and called the agreement advantageous to Finland.

Finnish Foreign Minister Witting gave Minister Schoenfeld an aide-mémoire stating German troops entered Finland under a September 1940 transit arrangement for movement to northern Norway, accepted because of Soviet pressure after the Moscow peace and Soviet demands including military transit to Hanko. Finland said German transports checked Soviet interference. After the U.S.S.R. attacked Finland in June 1941, German activity from Finnish territory became part of co-belligerency against a common enemy, without political commitments. Finland said it fought to safeguard its existence and security and valued friendly relations with the United States.

Schoenfeld asked Witting about links between German presence and the alleged Soviet attack, and about Finnish war aims. Witting said the 1941 attack continued Soviet aggression since 1939 and that destruction of Bolshevism was a Finnish war aim.

AMD Geode CS5535 Companion Device Silicon Revision A3 has multiple documented specification issues and workarounds. It does not meet USB over-voltage protection requirements, so external protection is required. Illegal LBAR values of 10000h or higher can be set but should not be used. Several clock-gating problems can cause missed PIC interrupts, lost GLIU statistics-counter ASMIs, UART CEIR failures, and USB controller register-read failures; affected automatic clock gating should be disabled. ATAC and ACC PRD prefetch behavior can create hazards with unaligned or modified PRD tables, requiring PRDs to be defined before use or modified safely ahead of the current entry.

UDMA and IDE-related issues include CRC corruption after certain device terminations, failed operation when bus mastering is enabled before PIO command packets, ATAPI failures after bus master enable with some CD-ROM behavior, and possible ATAC hangs with non-DWORD-aligned PRDs. Recommended actions include using UDMA I/O blocking, normal UDMA ordering, DWORD alignment, and stated driver procedures.

ACPI/PMC issues include unsupported byte access to PM1_EN and PM1_STS, possible corruption from WORD and BYTE PMC writes, nonfunctional S3 wake events except PWRBTN#, RTC CMOS read hazards after extended-port writes, LOWBAT_FLAG not being set after abnormal standby, and Sleep_X/Sleep_Y not deasserting if delay counters exceed PM_SED. Workarounds include avoiding byte accesses, using SMI traps, external wake circuitry, and programming delay counters below PM_SED.

Other issues include KEL status and snoop-mode register behavior requiring software workarounds, unsupported PIC polling mode, possible PCI back-to-back read failure with no real-world impact, unreliable CS5535-generated SSMIs, LPC DMA and LPC abort limitations, SMBus NEGACK and hold-time problems, GLPCI retry counter miscounting, and GPIO high-bank atomic writes clearing unselected bits after suspend. Several items have no operational impact or no resolution. AMD disclaims warranties, reserves the right to change products, and states the products are not intended for life-support or similar critical applications.

The passage presents AnveshanaAI, a practice-based AI/ML learning platform designed around automated question generation, adaptive learning, fairness, scalability, simulation, and competitive engagement. It reviews existing platforms such as StrataScratch, Sigmoid Academy, and Deep-ML, noting that they provide curated static problem sets but lack adaptive generation, difficulty calibration, and peer-driven feedback. Related research on LLM-based question generation, peer assessment, difficulty estimation, and domain-specific educational models is discussed as background.

AnveshanaAI uses a dataset of over 10,000 AI/ML problem–answer pairs built from academic materials, challenge repositories, research references, and human-authored tasks. Entries include metadata such as category, difficulty, tags, and Bloom’s taxonomy level. Augmentation includes difficulty scaling and cross-mode adaptation into coding, simulation, debugging, and viva formats. Validation uses LLM self-checks, static validation, sandbox execution, and rubric-based alignment.

The platform includes a learner panel with dashboards, category navigation, featured challenges, gamified progress tracking, and access to playground, challenges, simulator, dashboard, and community features. The administrator panel supports challenge creation, upload, augmentation, analytics, export, and LMS integration. Its architecture includes a question generation pipeline, adaptive delivery engine, multimodal interaction layer, analytics dashboard, fine-tuned LLMs, Docker sandboxes, vector databases, and Whisper-based ASR.

Experiments evaluate dataset quality, fine-tuning performance, and explainability. The dataset contains 10,845 questions across 26 categories, with balanced difficulty and Bloom-level coverage. Cramér’s V analysis shows strong category–difficulty correlation and weak correlations involving Bloom levels. Semantic similarity between question–answer pairs clusters between 0.6 and 0.8. A fine-tuned Mistral-7B model shows stable convergence, reduced validation perplexity, and interpretable token importance. Reported metrics include perplexity of 2.04 and BERTScore F1 of 0.427. The conclusion states that AnveshanaAI provides a reliable dataset and adaptive, interpretable educational platform.

This randomized, controlled superiority trial evaluated whether radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) plus a specific rehabilitation program (RP) was more effective and safe than sham rESWT plus RP for athletes with acute hamstring muscle complex injury type 3b. Semi-professional athletes aged 18–35 were recruited in Argentina between 2018 and 2020. After retrospective confirmation of diagnosis, 36 patients were included in the modified intent-to-treat population, with 18 in each group.

All patients completed an eight-week RP consisting of acute, subacute/regeneration, and functional phases, with progression based on pain, flexibility, strength, asymmetry, neuromuscular control, and functional criteria. The rESWT group received up to nine treatment sessions, three per week, while the sham group received identical-appearing treatment without shock wave energy. The primary outcome was time to return to sport; secondary outcomes were satisfaction at six months and re-injury within six months.

Median/mean time to return to sport was 25.5/25.4 days in the rESWT + RP group and 27.5/28.3 days in the sham rESWT + RP group, a statistically significant difference. Satisfaction scores did not differ significantly between groups. Re-injury occurred in one patient in each group, with one additional patient in each group lost to follow-up for this outcome.

The study concluded that, for athletes with acute HMC injury type 3b, adding rESWT to the specific rehabilitation program shortened time to return to sport compared with rehabilitation alone, without increasing re-injury in the observed period. The authors also stated that the rehabilitation program alone produced shorter return-to-sport times than other programs described in the literature.

The passage discloses methods and systems for a heterogeneous multi-chain framework, described as Polkadot, designed to provide shared security, interoperability, and scalability for multiple heterogeneous blockchains. Polkadot uses a relay-chain as a foundation chain hosting parachains, which are parallelized chains or data structures with potentially different characteristics and state-transition functions.

In one implementation, validator nodes on the relay-chain receive candidate block headers and state-transition proofs from collator nodes on parachains, validate them, rebroadcast valid candidates, and participate in consensus to produce relay-chain blocks containing parachain candidates. Invalid candidate blocks caused by malicious or Byzantine nodes may be detected, reverted, and punished.

The network includes several participant roles. Validators help seal relay-chain blocks and validate parachain blocks, while nominators stake behind validators. Collators maintain full parachain nodes, collect and execute transactions, and propose parachain block candidates. Fishermen monitor for illegal behavior and may receive rewards for proving validator misconduct. Misbehavior may result in reduced rewards, bond reduction, or bond confiscation.

Polkadot separates consensus from transaction execution to improve scalability and allows interchain communication through routed transactions between parachains. The relay-chain maintains transaction queues, parachain registries, validator management, staking, governance, and parachain administration. The disclosure also discusses mechanisms for parachain validation, interchain routing, data availability, validator selection through nominated proof-of-stake, punishment systems, and possible interoperability with Ethereum and Bitcoin through bridge-like mechanisms.

U.S. stocks sold off Tuesday after Caterpillar said it did not expect to exceed its first-quarter profit for the rest of 2018, raising concerns that higher oil prices, material costs and interest rates could slow profit growth. The Dow fell 424.56 points to 24,024.13 after dropping as much as 619 points, while the S&P 500 lost 1.3 percent and the Nasdaq fell 1.7 percent. Caterpillar dropped 6.2 percent, 3M fell 6.8 percent, and technology companies including Alphabet, Facebook, Microsoft and Amazon also declined. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly reached 3 percent for the first time since January 2014 before ending at 2.99 percent. Oil prices fell, gold and metals rose, and overseas markets were mixed.

In Jane Richmond v. Walter M. Richmond, the court held that alimony has no fixed general rule and must depend on each case’s circumstances. Allowances are not determined solely by current rents and profits or by the complainant’s wants, and the defendant’s property is valued at the time of the master’s report. After granting Jane Richmond a divorce for Walter Richmond’s adultery and placing the children in her care, the court reduced the master’s recommended allowance based on revised evidence of Walter’s property and debts. The decree awarded Jane $250 annually for support and $390 annually for the three children’s maintenance, education, and clothing, payable half-yearly, with security required. The decree allowed enforcement by sequestration or other lawful process, made the decree a lien on Walter’s New Jersey property, and permitted either party to seek future modification if circumstances changed. Walter was also ordered to pay Jane’s costs.

Veterans say a concrete dome on Runit Island in the Enewetak Atoll, containing radioactive waste from U.S. nuclear tests and cleanup, is leaking into the Pacific Ocean. The atoll was used for weapons tests in the 1950s, and more than 8,000 workers later moved contaminated soil and debris into a blast crater sealed with a concrete dome. Cleanup veterans argue the crater was not drained or lined, coral beneath it is porous and fractured, and tides and storms are moving radioactive water into the lagoon and ocean. Some veterans report serious health problems they attribute to radiation exposure and say they were given inadequate protective equipment. One draughtsman involved in the dome’s construction said it was designed to slow, not stop, radiation migration. Experts said the danger depends on how much radiation escapes and whether it enters food or water, with cancer risk being the main concern, though individual cases cannot be definitively attributed to exposure.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on October 26, 2015, to recast previously reported financial information from its 2015 Form 10-K to reflect segment reporting changes following a June 2015 organizational realignment. Beginning in fiscal 2016, Microsoft reports under three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, using operating income as the measure of segment profitability. The filing recasts consolidated financial statements for the three years ended June 30, 2015, as required by SEC rules, but does not restate audited financial statements or reflect events after the 2015 Form 10-K. Exhibits include updated business, MD&A, financial statement information, auditor consent, and XBRL files.

Nursery headteachers warned that hundreds of council-funded nursery schools in England could close if supplementary government funding ends after 2020. A new 2017 funding system was followed by £60m a year in extra support until 2019-20, but its future is uncertain. Heads said budget cuts, rising costs, reduced special needs funding and staffing pressures are making schools unsustainable. Only 400 council-funded nursery schools remain, offering about 30,000 places, with more than six in ten in deprived areas. Children and Families Minister Nadhim Zahawi said maintained nursery schools are valuable and urged councils not to make premature decisions while the government continues discussions. Some Conservative MPs also called for funding certainty, warning that children with disabilities and medical needs could be most affected.

The lecture reviews the theorem of irrelevance in detection theory, explaining that for white Gaussian noise channels only the received components in the signal’s finite-dimensional subspace matter; noise and signals outside that subspace are irrelevant if independent. This implies that modulation choices are equivalent for Gaussian noise analysis, with differences arising mainly from practical synchronization, filtering, and implementation issues.

The professor then discusses detecting sequences of PAM/QAM signals. If input symbols are independent and noise components are independent, maximum likelihood detection symbol-by-symbol gives the same decisions as joint detection over the whole sequence. If inputs are dependent, such as after error-correction coding, using the full observation can reduce error probability, motivating probabilistic decoding methods over purely algebraic coding.

The lecture compares orthogonal, simplex, and biorthogonal signal sets. Simplex codes remove the mean from orthogonal codes and reduce one degree of freedom while preserving error probability after scaling, with lower energy than orthogonal codes. Biorthogonal codes add negated codewords, keeping the same energy but roughly doubling likely error events. For dimensions greater than two, exact error probability becomes more complex because decision regions are not orthogonal.

The professor derives bounds on error probability for large orthogonal signal sets in Gaussian noise by conditioning on the received component in the transmitted direction. This leads to an exponential decay of error probability with the number of transmitted bits when energy per bit exceeds the channel-capacity threshold, stated as \(E_b/N_0 = \ln 2\), connecting the argument to Shannon’s channel capacity theorem.

The lecture then transitions to wireless communication. Unlike wired Gaussian channels, wireless channels vary with time, involve fading and interference, and require considering multiple transmitters and receivers. Cellular networks are described as extensions of wired networks, with mobiles communicating through base stations and switching offices. Key issues include selecting base stations, locating mobiles, handling reverse/multiple-access and forward/broadcast channels, and supporting both voice and data despite different delay requirements. The lecture closes by introducing physical modeling questions for wireless channels, including carrier frequency, bandwidth, Doppler shift, time variation, frequency dependence, and simple propagation/reflection models.

The passage argues that Exxon Mobil is attractive for dividend investors due to its stock trading near 2015 lows, a 4.1% dividend yield, 20% year-over-year cash flow growth, discounted valuation metrics, and expectations to double earnings by 2025. It says crude oil and natural gas show signs of stabilization, which could support energy stocks. Stefon Diggs had 10 catches for 146 yards in the Patriots’ Sunday Night Football win over the Bills, matching Julian Edelman as the latest New England player with consecutive 100-yard games in a season. He also recorded 61 yards after the catch, his most since 2022.
TopoSPAM provides multiscale biological simulation tools for intracellular polar fluids, gels, nematics, and tissue-scale curved-surface and 3D morphogenesis models.

Mega Geometry’s GPU-driven cluster generation and fast BVH construction support subdivision surfaces by enabling tessellation directly into clusters and rapid BVH builds, improving real-time ray tracing performance for animated or changing viewpoints.

The passage describes a display apparatus with a flexible vibration module attached to the rear surface of a display panel to vibrate the panel and generate sound or haptic feedback. The module includes piezoelectric inorganic first portions and flexible organic second portions arranged on the same layer, improving flexibility, impact resistance, sound pressure, and sound localization. It may be applied to curved, rollable, bendable, and flexible displays.

The flexible vibration module may include electrode layers, protection films, and piezoelectric composite layers with various patterns, including line, circular, triangular, and multi-layer bimorph structures. The passage also describes manufacturing the module by forming a piezoelectric composite from inorganic and organic materials, adding electrodes, polarizing the inorganic portions, and applying protection films. Embodiments include single or multiple vibration modules on a display panel, with partition members and air gaps to separate sound regions and support stereo sound output.

Oklahoma received federal approval to launch a voluntary program negotiating rebates from drug-makers when medicines do not perform as claimed. OHCA is in talks with 20 companies, with 10 actively discussing or negotiating contracts.

Kalidou Koulibaly scored a stoppage-time header to give Napoli a 1-0 win away to Juventus, cutting Juve’s Serie A lead to one point with four games remaining. Juventus had chances through Miralem Pjanic and others, while Napoli threatened through Lorenzo Insigne, Marek Hamsik and substitutes. Giorgio Chiellini went off injured early, and Juventus later replaced Paulo Dybala with Juan Cuadrado. The defeat leaves Juventus facing a difficult run-in, including matches against Inter and Roma, while Napoli next visit Fiorentina as they pursue their first Scudetto since 1989-90.

A bullish engulfing pattern is a two-candlestick bullish reversal pattern that forms after a downward price swing, with a larger bullish candle completely engulfing a smaller bearish candle. It often appears near support levels and may signal a shift from bearish to bullish momentum, especially after a significant pullback in an uptrend. Traders are advised to confirm the signal with follow-through price action, consider broader market conditions, support and resistance, volume, and use defined entry, exit, risk management, and backtesting rules before trading.

Some P.E.I. parents are concerned about uneven school supply costs. Cornwall parent Jerica Devos has spent about $70 for her son’s Grade 1 supplies from Westwood Primary School’s list and says costs should be consistent across schools. Some schools require parents to buy specific supplies, including requested brands and colours, while others buy supplies and charge a flat fee capped at $40. The Public Schools Branch provides a master supply list, but schools may adjust quantities, colours and brands, though they cannot add items. Parents at fee-based schools may opt out and buy supplies themselves, but parents at list-based schools cannot choose a flat fee. Public Schools Branch director Parker Grimmer said feedback is welcome, and Devos plans to raise her concerns with the school and branch.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that at a March 21, 2018 special stockholder meeting, stockholders approved the performance-based stock option award granted to CEO Elon Musk on January 21, 2018. Approval required majority votes under NASDAQ rules, Tesla’s bylaws, and a disinterested standard excluding shares owned by Elon and Kimbal Musk. The award received 96,795,092 votes for and 23,407,632 against under the NASDAQ and bylaws standards, representing about 81% of votes cast and 80% of voting power present and entitled to vote, respectively. Under the disinterested standard, it received 63,014,339 votes for and 23,407,632 against, or about 73% of votes cast excluding the Musk shares.

Disability activist research found that disabled taxi passengers in much of Scotland may not benefit from a new Equality Act provision because most councils have not created required Section 167 lists of wheelchair-accessible taxis. The law, enacted in April, allows fines of up to £1,000 for drivers who refuse wheelchair users or charge extra, but only applies where councils maintain such lists. Only Perth and Kinross has completed one, and seven more councils expect to meet the recommended October deadline. Eighteen Scottish councils have no plans or are undecided. Across England, Scotland and Wales, 11% of councils have created lists and 30% plan to do so this year. Doug Paulley and Muscular Dystrophy UK urged councils and government to act. The research also found many councils have few wheelchair-accessible taxis, and only 30% require disability awareness training for taxi drivers.

VentureWire’s Dec. 7, 2000 issue reported major private equity and venture activity, including Providence Equity Partners closing a $2.8 billion Fund IV, Insight Capital Partners raising a $750 million fourth fund, and Caspian Networks raising $85 million in third-round funding. Other financing news included PacketVideo seeking $80 million to $100 million, GiantBear raising $25 million, Advent Networks raising $22.6 million, Xpert receiving $15 million, Quidnunc raising $14.5 million, Mediatrix closing $14.5 million, InfoMedics raising $10 million, and Rivenet raising $8 million.

The issue also covered launches and deals, including BiblioMondo.com’s launch, Telaric’s planned incubator services, a Brightstar–IncuVest alliance, Beliefnet.com’s acquisition of CharityCounts.com, FilmTrust’s acquisition of IFILM software assets, the Dairy.com and INC2inc merger forming Momentx, and BuyMedia’s planned acquisition of REP-PAK Media Systems. It reported multiple board and executive appointments, Optical Capital Group staffing its San Francisco office, and corrections involving InPhonic, Nisus, and Salesnet.

This prospective cohort study evaluated whether baseline lung ultrasound findings predicted oxygen support needs or death among 264 adults hospitalized with COVID-19 at Johns Hopkins Hospital. Researchers used standardized point-of-care lung ultrasound and calculated a mean lung ultrasound score (mLUSS) across available lung zones. Higher mLUSS was associated with progression to ICU-level care and 28-day mortality, independent of symptom duration, but not with the composite outcome of ventilation or death. A lines were associated with lower risk of deterioration, while pleural abnormalities were associated with higher risk of mechanical ventilation plus death and death. The study concludes that individual lung ultrasound findings and mLUSS may help prognosticate oxygen requirement or death in hospitalized COVID-19 patients, even when all 12 lung zones are not available.

Todd Kimberlain forwarded V. Charles Weldon an email from Jack Beven containing Jim Gross’s note about a file of hurricane watch and warning areas from 1963 to 1998, constructed by Mark Demaria and assumed complete for the continental U.S. The file format lists month, day, year, hour, storm name, number of warnings, and storm ID. Warning codes are defined as: 6 hurricane warning, 5 hurricane watch, 4 storm warning, 3 gale warning, 2 tropical storm warning, and 1 tropical storm watch. The remainder is a chronological dataset of storm-related watch and warning areas by coastal location.

An international study involving UCL found that established alien species have increased continuously worldwide over the past 200 years, with no overall sign of saturation. Using more than 45,000 first records covering over 16,000 species, researchers found that 37% of recorded introductions occurred between 1970 and 2014, peaking in 1996 with 585 new alien species recorded. Trends varied by organism group: plants, birds and mammals rose in the 19th century, while algae, molluscs and insects increased sharply after 1950, linked to trade globalisation. Except for mammals and fishes, recent introduction rates show no slowdown. Researchers warned of impacts on native ecosystems and said stronger prevention policies are needed.

A researcher discussed how weight loss lowers calorie needs, noting that losing 5% of body weight may require 10% fewer calories to maintain. The passage also mentions dMeetings for diabetes patient education.

Lenovo’s Legion Go S with SteamOS is $120 off and presented as a capable, more compact gaming handheld for SteamOS users. The author prefers it over the Windows model, citing easier setup and game access. It is bulky but comfortable, with strong controls, a bright 120-Hz IPS screen, 1 TB storage, 32 GB memory, and MicroSD support. It may require settings tweaks for newer games but performed well and felt more powerful than an older Steam Deck.

Mercedes-Benz has introduced a “Grand Edition” package for non-AMG GLS-Class SUVs to keep its flagship SUV competitive. It adds 20-inch alloy wheels, “Grand Edition” badges, nappa leather dashboard, unique wood trim, exclusive leather colour combinations, diamond-quilted seats, special piping and velour mats. The €8,250 upgrade is available from the GLS 350d 4Matic to GLS 500 4Matic, with deliveries starting March 2018.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated April 26, 2022, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2022. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Alice L. Jolla, Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer.

This study evaluated pathologist-directed comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) for advanced solid tumor patients at Providence from September 2019 to November 2021. CGP was initiated at diagnosis, used a standardized 523-gene DNA/RNA assay, and was provided at no cost under a research protocol. The cohort included 3,216 patients; 1,482 had documented follow-up and treatment data.

CGP results were available earlier in clinical decision-making than prior oncologist-ordered small-panel testing, while maintaining a median turnaround time of 14 days. Overall, 49% of tested cases had at least one guideline-based actionable biomarker, with TMB-high, BRAF, and EGFR among the most common. CGP identified more actionable alterations and clinical trial matches than an in silico legacy 50-gene panel: 67% versus 33% for guideline-based or trial-matched actionability.

Among treated patients, precision therapy and immunotherapy use was common. Fifty-nine percent of patients with actionable targeted therapy biomarkers received targeted therapy, and 63% of patients with immunotherapy-associated biomarkers received immunotherapy with or without chemotherapy. Across all tumor types, biomarker-guided targeted therapy or immunotherapy was associated with improved overall survival compared with chemotherapy alone. Median overall survival was 25 months for targeted therapy versus 17 months for chemotherapy; in NSCLC, it was 26 months versus 16 months.

The study reports that precision therapies overtook traditional cytotoxic treatments in this community-based advanced cancer cohort and were associated with better survival, while noting remaining barriers including CGP adoption, payer coverage, physician education, and access to precision treatments.

Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko appeared alive at a Kiev news conference after Ukrainian police had reported he was shot dead. Ukrainian security officials said his death was faked to prevent a planned killing. Security chief Vasyl Gritsak said a Ukrainian citizen was recruited and paid $40,000 by Russian security services to organize the attack. Babchenko, a Kremlin critic and war reporter, fled Russia in 2017 after threats and continued facing intimidation in Kiev, where he worked for a Crimean Tatar TV station.

FoLix is an FDA-cleared, in-office fractional laser treatment for hair loss that offers a nonsurgical alternative to transplants. It stimulates existing hair follicles by creating microscopic scalp channels that trigger healing responses, circulation, and growth signals. Sessions take 20 to 30 minutes, require no anesthesia, have little to no downtime, and cost about $750 to $1,250 each. Patients typically need three to six sessions in the first year, followed by maintenance up to twice yearly. Dermatologists say it is best for early to moderate hair loss and not for complete baldness or extensive scarring. Possible temporary side effects include redness, tightness, scalp sensitivity, and shedding. Doctors advise consulting a physician because hair loss can have multiple causes.

An infant injured during delivery received reduced damages after a negligence verdict against a municipal hospital and staff member. The court upheld the reduced award and declined to reinstate the jury’s original future pain and suffering award.

Protesters gathered Sunday in several U.S. cities against hatred, racism and white nationalism after deadly violence in Charlottesville. Events included marches, arrests in Seattle, demonstrations in Denver and New York, and a Charlottesville vigil.

Birel ART-supported teams competed among 191 drivers in Round 2 of the Florida Winter Tour ROK Edition at Palm Beach. Ryan Norberg won ROK Senior and regained the championship lead, while Scott Davidson earned his first ROK Shifter Masters win of the season. This study examines the distance education experiences of visually impaired students receiving professional music education in Turkey during COVID-19. Using a qualitative case study design, data were collected through semi-structured interviews with seven undergraduate and graduate students and analyzed by content analysis. Most courses were conducted synchronously, though some students followed recordings asynchronously due to accessibility, health, or system issues. Students used computers, phones, or tablets independently, but course materials often did not address their special needs; some required support from parents or friends. Assessment practices varied, with some individual accommodations and some general arrangements that created difficulties, especially in theoretical courses.

Participants identified time and place flexibility and, for one student, increased social acceptance as strengths of distance education. Weaknesses included low efficiency, technical problems such as poor sound synchronization and transmission, limited suitability of platforms for music education, and some instructors’ technological inadequacy. Students suggested accessible systems, audio conversion tools, screen-size controls, Braille or digital notation archives, faster technical support, and more understanding teacher attitudes.

The study concludes that visually impaired students were largely overlooked in distance education planning, which was designed mainly for normally developing students. It emphasizes the need for accessible technologies, customized materials, support systems, and cooperation among educators, families, and professionals.

The speaker says the team had scoring chances but missed, must stay positive, focus on the next important game, avoid lapses and turnovers against a strong opponent, and continue believing in themselves as they prepare for the third game at home.
