The speaker said he felt comfortable returning to play, was more concerned about being hit from behind into the boards than head contact, and felt he played well before running out of steam in the third period. He attributed postgame cramping to possible dehydration and travel, but said he felt fine after treatment and rest. Doctors reviewed his CT scan and determined his current risk was not significantly different from what it would be in September, allowing him to play. He said he cannot change his playing style, wants to contribute to the team, and is grateful for the opportunity. He expects being at home, resting properly, and following a normal routine to help before the next game. He said the team needs better execution, more passion, and harder play to win the Stanley Cup at home. The CT scan was arranged after another player’s injury raised the possibility he might play, and his family and team were supportive after doctors reassured them.

This bibliometric study examined mathematics anxiety in mathematics education using Scopus-indexed open-access English journal articles from 2013–2023. After filtering and cleaning, 324 articles were analyzed with VOSviewer and Biblioshiny. Publications increased over the decade, with the highest number in 2022. Mathematics anxiety was linked to variables including gender, achievement, motivation, self-efficacy, skills, teachers, technology, and performance. The main recurring themes were “math anxiety” and “mathematics anxiety.” Frontiers in Psychology published the most articles on the topic. Garcia-Santillan was the most productive author, while the United States produced the most publications and international collaborations. Germany had the most citations, and the University of Barcelona was the most relevant affiliation. The study notes limitations from using only Scopus and article document types.

North Korea warned it was ready to respond to nuclear attacks and all-out war while displaying new intercontinental and submarine-launched ballistic missiles during a parade marking Kim Il-sung’s 105th birth anniversary. The event came amid tensions with the US, speculation over a nuclear test, and China’s warning that conflict could erupt at any moment.

NVIDIA filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2020. Revenue was $3.866 billion for the quarter, up from $2.579 billion a year earlier, and $6.946 billion for the six-month period, up from $4.799 billion. Quarterly net income was $622 million, or $0.99 diluted EPS, compared with $552 million, or $0.90 diluted EPS, in the prior-year quarter. Six-month net income was $1.539 billion, or $2.47 diluted EPS.

NVIDIA completed its $7.134 billion acquisition of Mellanox on April 27, 2020. Mellanox contributed about 14% of consolidated revenue in the quarter and was included in the Compute & Networking segment. NVIDIA changed its reportable segments to Graphics and Compute & Networking. Quarterly Graphics revenue was $2.085 billion, while Compute & Networking revenue was $1.781 billion. By market platform, quarterly revenue was $1.654 billion for Gaming, $203 million for Professional Visualization, $1.752 billion for Data Center, $111 million for Automotive, and $146 million for OEM and Other.

As of July 26, 2020, NVIDIA had $25.180 billion in total assets, $11.266 billion in total liabilities, and $13.914 billion in shareholders’ equity. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled about $10.981 billion. Long-term debt was $6.960 billion. NVIDIA paid $197 million in dividends during the first half of fiscal 2021.

The passage describes a patent application for a detection model training method, apparatus, terminal device, and storage medium in information processing technologies, particularly for medical image detection such as colorectal polyp detection. Existing systems using convolutional neural networks and support vector machines may perform poorly because labeled private training data is limited, expensive to obtain, and varies across hospitals due to different devices and operating habits.

The proposed method trains a detection model using an initial training model that includes an initial detection model and an adaptive model. Training samples include labeled source domain images, which indicate whether a target object is present and identify their domain, and unlabeled target domain images, which identify only their domain. The initial detection model determines whether a target object is present in source images, while the adaptive model classifies the domain of images. A loss function is calculated from detection results, domain classification results, and identifiers, and model parameters are adjusted to obtain a final detection model.

In some embodiments, the method applies to user body organ images and lesion targets, including colorectal images and polyps. The initial detection model may include a feature extraction module and a detection/classification module, while the adaptive model may include a domain classification module and optionally a gradient inversion module. The approach allows unlabeled target domain images to be used in training, increasing usable training data and reducing domain differences between hospitals. The final model can detect whether a lesion is present and, if present, determine its type and location. The passage also describes corresponding apparatus units, a terminal device, and a computer-readable storage medium for implementing the method.

The passage is a May 25, 2001 Enron news digest covering U.S. energy politics, California’s energy crisis, and Enron’s Dabhol Power dispute in India. A New York Times article reports conflicting accounts of a phone call between Enron Chairman Kenneth Lay and FERC Chairman Curtis Hebert Jr. about deregulation and support for Hebert’s role, while noting Enron’s political influence, campaign contributions, and possible replacement of Hebert by Pat Wood.

Several articles focus on Dabhol Power Co., 65 percent owned by Enron, after the Maharashtra State Electricity Board moved to cancel its power purchase agreement, citing performance issues and disputed bills. Enron rejected the cancellation as improper and said it would continue seeking a resolution. Reports also discuss unpaid bills, penalties, possible government liabilities, negotiations, Bechtel’s threat to withdraw over unpaid dues, and speculation about Enron selling its stake.

Other items address California energy tensions, including criticism of power suppliers, calls for civility between state and federal leaders, market reactions affecting energy stocks, Portland General Electric’s higher revenues amid volatile power costs, Australian interest in India’s energy and mining sectors, renewed business school interest in energy careers, and a FERC hearing into allegations involving El Paso and California natural gas prices.

Teams should prepare for defensive, even, and offensive jump ball situations. Defensive jump balls occur when the opponent has a clear advantage; players should rotate early, read the jumper’s eyes and hand, deny forward tips, box out, protect the basket, and maintain contact with the jumper. Defensive alignments include box, diamond, and “Y,” with back defenders used to prevent easy shots when the opponent has a superior jumper.

Even jump balls require boxing out, inside position, anticipation, aggressiveness, and coordinated clockwise or counter-clockwise rotations based on a predetermined signal.

Offensive jump balls are used when a team has a clear height or jumping advantage. Teams generally tip forward to the biggest player, maintain defensive balance, and move into offense if no shot is available. Proven offensive plays include Ball Possession, Double Tap, Post Split, Jumper Fly, Forward Fly, Spread, Tandem, and Loop, all designed to gain possession or create quick scoring opportunities while preserving defensive balance.

Tropical Depression 02W made landfall in the eastern Visayas on April 15, 2017, then weakened into a remnant low after crossing parts of the Philippines and entering the South China Sea. NASA’s Terra satellite observed its elongated cloud area on April 17. JTWC reported compact circulation moving west but expected wind shear and dry air to prevent re-intensification.

Apple removed several ICE-related apps from its App Store, including Eyes Up, ICEBlock, and DEICER, after US attorney general Pam Bondi claimed such tools endanger ICE officers. Developers Joshua Aaron and Mark said they plan to fight or appeal the bans, while some apps remain available through Google Play or websites. Apple did not comment; Google has also removed ICE monitoring apps and reportedly considers ICE officers a vulnerable group. Legal and digital rights experts told WIRED the apps publish protected speech and warned that centralized app stores give companies significant control over communication tools.

Alberta Education Minister David Eggen said the province may allow Rocky View County parents to pay school bus fees despite Bill 1, which eliminated fees for students living 2.4 kilometres or more from their designated school. Rocky View Schools faces a $1 million transportation shortfall and has surveyed parents on options including altered bell times, longer rural commutes and moving bus stops. Board chair Todd Brand said many parents preferred paying previous fees, and the district will contact the Ministry of Education.

The court considered whether double jeopardy bars separate convictions and sentences under 18 U.S.C. §§ 924(c) and 924(j) for the same conduct. The argument focused on whether Congress clearly authorized cumulative punishment, including through Section 924(c)(1)(D)(ii)’s consecutive-sentence language or Section 924(c)’s “in addition to” language. Justices questioned how these provisions apply to Section 924(j), which lacks similar wording. McCloud argued statutory structure and purpose show congressional intent, while Barrett and the government disputed that. Justice Gorsuch raised broader double jeopardy theories, but the passage suggests the court is unlikely to address them in detail.

Texas Instruments provides current mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for designated devices, subject to change without notice. Notes define product status, preproduction material limitations, RoHS values, lead finish options, moisture sensitivity and reflow ratings, and part marking conventions. TI states that information is based partly on third parties and is not warranted for accuracy. Technical resources are provided “as is,” intended for skilled developers, and users are responsible for product selection, design, validation, testing, and compliance. TI disclaims warranties, limits liability, restricts resource use, and applies its Terms of Sale.

Schizophrenia spectrum disorder lacks widely applicable objective biomarkers. This study aimed to develop clinically viable resting-state functional connectivity MRI classifiers for SSD and examine whether diagnostic connectivity markers could also serve as trait, state, or staging markers. Using discovery and validation multi-disorder datasets of 1,015 and 683 participants, respectively, the study found reproducible diagnostic effects across functional connections. LASSO classifiers achieved 79.6% accuracy in cross-validation and 77.3% accuracy in independent validation, identifying 47 important functional connections, 44 of which showed consistent group differences across datasets. Voting classifiers improved sensitivity over LASSO classifiers, though AUC did not differ significantly. LASSO performance was not affected by tested confounders, while voting classifiers may have been partly influenced by age. Classifier sensitivity varied by disease severity, with voting classifiers showing less imbalance across severity subgroups. A laterality imbalance was observed among frequently selected regions in important functional connections.

Shohei Ohtani started Game 1 of the 2025 NLDS for the Dodgers against the Phillies at Citizens Bank Park, his first postseason pitching appearance. During the 2025 regular season, he pitched in 14 games, going 1-1 with a 2.87 ERA, 62 strikeouts, and 15 earned runs in 47 innings. Manager Dave Roberts hoped Ohtani could pitch through six innings and into the seventh. In the first inning, Ohtani struck out Trea Turner, retired Kyle Schwarber on a fly ball, and got Bryce Harper to ground out. He also struck out in his first at-bat against Cristopher Sanchez. The game aired on TBS and truTV and streamed on HBO Max.

After the Las Vegas mass shooting at the Route 91 Harvest festival, which killed 58 people and injured more than 500, country musician Charlie Daniels called the attack an anomaly and said people should not let fear keep them from concerts. He supported NRA-backed regulation of bump stock devices but opposed broader gun-control efforts, arguing that many politicians misunderstand firearms and that stricter laws would leave people defenseless. The passage also notes debate over country music’s ties to the NRA and Rosanne Cash’s call for country musicians to oppose the organization.

Amazon’s mobile accessory kit lets earbuds and wearables integrate Alexa, and Jabra Elite 65t is among the first earbuds to use it. Testing found Alexa on the earbuds, currently Android-only with iOS support planned, has major limitations compared with Alexa on smart speakers and with Google Assistant or Siri. It cannot make calls, send texts, provide navigation, support reminders, or play music from services like Spotify; only Amazon Music works through Alexa, with limited playback controls. Timers and alarms can be set but do not notify through the app.

The earbuds can answer calls by voice, and call quality is decent in some conditions but struggles with noise. Alexa offers access to skills and strong voice shopping, including reordering and package updates. Google Assistant and Siri provide better messaging, notifications, reminders, and navigation.

Jabra Elite 65t delivers strong sound quality, comfortable fit, and a HearThrough ambient-sound mode. Downsides include limited case battery capacity compared with Pixel Buds and AirPods and no tracker feature. Overall, the earbuds have excellent audio, but Alexa voice control is incomplete for mobile use.

Digital leaders respond to changing competitive landscapes by taking sensible risks, experimenting, and using data-driven feedback to learn and adapt. They value experimentation for its learning benefits, while using planning and assessment to manage costs. They also invest in long-term employee development, especially critical thinking skills like problem solving, statistics, and design thinking.

Energy sector trading involves gaining exposure to energy stocks for diversification and profit, either through ETFs such as XLE and VDE or individual stocks. The S&P 500 energy sector includes oil and natural gas companies involved in exploration, refining, distribution, and related services. As of July 18, 2022, the sector had outperformed the S&P 500 over one year. The passage says energy is difficult to trade because commodity-related markets and oil prices are driven by macro factors. It presents two unrevealed XLE trading strategies: one with 198 trades, 0.61% average gain, 6.4% CAGR, 65% win ratio, 13% max drawdown, and 2.1 profit factor; another with 335 trades, 0.21% average gain, 59% win rate, 8% max drawdown, 1.75 profit factor, and 3% annual return. The five cited major S&P 500 energy stocks are Exxon Mobil, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, EOG Resources, and Schlumberger. The passage emphasizes diversification as the main reason to consider energy sector trading.

The speaker praises Winnipeg as a passionate Canadian hockey market with strong fan support and confidence in the organization under Mr. Chipman. He recalls playing at the old Winnipeg Arena and MTS Centre, including fans chanting “We want the Jets,” and says a smaller full arena is preferable to a larger empty one. He also discusses learning to tell Daniel and Henrik apart, noting Henrik speaks up more, and describes preparing to face goalie Thomas by choosing when to shoot, look back door, or aim for rebounds while crediting his skill.

Willis Eschenbach analyzes Mauna Loa Observatory solar radiation and temperature data to examine atmospheric clarity and the effects of the El Chichon and Pinatubo eruptions. He finds that, aside from volcanic periods, maximum sunlight at Mauna Loa has been largely unchanged since 1980. During the two years after each eruption, maximum and average solar radiation decreased similarly, with total downwelling solar radiation about 24.5 W/m² lower than non-volcanic periods. He argues that cloud behavior reduced the expected loss, consistent with his theory that clouds respond to oppose forcing changes. Despite the reduced solar radiation, Mauna Loa and other Hawaiian temperature records showed no clear cooling from either eruption. An update says wind-speed differences did not appear to explain the temperature result.

The Toronto Stock Exchange financial sector had a volatile March and declining April, with the big five Canadian banks falling from February highs by 4.6% to 7.5%. The author compares these banks with five smaller Canadian lending companies using beta, earnings yield, dividend yield, payout ratio, and dividend history. The big five have maintained dividends for over ten years, while First National, Home Capital, and Equitable have cut dividends. Atrium Mortgage and MCAN Mortgage have maintained or increased dividends and offer yields above 7%, though with high payout ratios. In the ranking, MCAN placed first, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce second, and Atrium third. Equitable ranked worst due to the highest beta and lowest dividend yield. The author notes small-cap lenders may offer higher dividend yields and smaller price swings, but have lower liquidity and less diversified business models than the big banks.

The passage outlines defensive approaches to the Hawk Offense, which features wing isolation, a high-post shuffle cut, and weakside post-up action. It emphasizes defending dribble penetration, disrupting shuffle cuts, and handling low-post threats. The Basic NBA Show and Recover strategy avoids switching big-small screens, instead using help defenders to show, bump cutters or shooters wide, then recover while primary defenders chase and deny passes. The All Out “SOS” Disruption strategy traps the wing ballhandler near the sideline, rotates defenders on passes out of the trap, switches on shuffle cuts and down screens, fronts post players, and applies SOS principles, including baseline and post trap rotations when needed.

AMD is re-entering high-end graphics card competition with the Radeon RX Vega 64 and Vega 56, targeting Nvidia’s GTX 1080 and GTX 1070 respectively. AMD says Vega 64 is not meant to beat the GTX 1080 Ti, leaving Nvidia likely ahead in single-card performance. Vega 56 may compete on price, costing $50 less than the GTX 1070 in the U.S., though UK pricing may be less favorable. AMD’s advantages include CrossFire support for up to three cards, the X399/Threadripper platform’s 64 PCI-E lanes, and the FreeSync ecosystem, supported by cheaper monitors, Enhanced Sync, and claimed improvements to minimum frame rates.

Madison Snap and William Francis were convicted and fined for shooting and wounding a mare trespassing in an oat field protected by an insufficient fence. The court held that trespassing and crop damage did not justify injuring the animal. A property owner may expel trespassing stock or take lawful measures to protect crops, but may not inflict unnecessary injury. The conviction and fines were affirmed.

Old paper £10 notes will cease to be legal tender in the UK on 1 March and will no longer be accepted by retailers. After the deadline, they can be exchanged at banks, building societies, post offices or the Bank of England, possibly with ID. The new polymer £10 note featuring Jane Austen entered circulation in September 2017.

Researchers said the Great Barrier Reef has recovered from near-extinction five times in the past 30,000 years by shifting seaward or landward as sea levels changed, migrating 20 centimetres to 1.5 metres per year. However, they warned it may not withstand today’s rapid warming, acidification and other stresses. Past die-offs were linked to exposure during falling sea levels, inundation during rising sea levels, and a sediment event about 10,000 years ago. Recent coral bleaching from warming seas has caused major damage, including a 2016 die-off that killed nearly a third of the reef’s coral.

A safety is a defensive back typically positioned deepest on the defense and serves as the last line of defense against big plays. Safeties help defend passes, support run defense, cover receivers, tight ends or running backs, and communicate across the defense. The two traditional types are free safety and strong safety. Free safeties often roam the deep middle and rely on speed and coverage ability, while strong safeties usually play closer to the line, tackle more, and help stop the run.

The position is called safety because the player protects against long gains or touchdowns. Other names include Rover for a strong safety and Star for an extra safety in special packages. Older terms such as defensive fullback and defensive halfback are still used in Canadian football but not traditional American football.

Modern safeties need athleticism, speed, tackling ability, coverage skills, and strong communication. Notable safeties mentioned include Troy Polamalu, Ed Reed, Ken Houston, Steve Atwater, Ronnie Lott, Brian Dawkins, Emlen Tunnell, Larry Wilson, and Sean Taylor. A strong safety can create turnovers, limit passing options, support cornerbacks, and give the defense confidence, but mistakes can lead directly to touchdowns.
Jane Goodall died on October 1 at age 91. The passage highlights her legacy in primatology, including living chimp stories and enduring skeletons.

The report responds to the 2024 Arab Summit initiative to ensure free, appropriate education for every Arab child, citing UNESCO’s 2018 figure that over 10 million Arab children aged 5–15 are out of school. It focuses on education in conflict zones, using Syria as the main example, and proposes the “Hope” initiative to provide remedial and preventive solutions.

The study emphasizes inclusivity, restoring hope, addressing mental health impacts of conflict, building resilience through family and caregiver support, responding to educational and psychosocial challenges, supporting Syria’s long-term recovery, and maintaining education during conflict. The literature review states that conflict disrupts early childhood education through displacement, school destruction, insecurity, resource shortages, limited teacher training, fragmented curricula, and inequitable access for marginalized groups. It also highlights trauma, toxic stress, behavioral challenges, and long-term effects on literacy, numeracy, social development, poverty, and instability.

The report notes that over two million children in Syria remain out of education, with poverty, displacement, school damage, child labor, and lack of resources contributing to dropout. It also cites nearly 400,000 Syrian refugee children in Turkey being out of school due to poverty, early marriage, child labor, legal documentation issues, language barriers, distance, and financial problems.

The methodology used triangulation, combining interviews and surveys. Interviews with a parent and child affected by war showed destroyed schools, relocation, scarce textbooks, unreliable internet, anxiety, lack of psychological support, unsafe study spaces, and limited learning time. A case study of Ahmed in Alkhabor, Syria, described poor infrastructure, lack of electricity and internet, limited tutoring, farming and caregiving responsibilities, and continued belief in education as a path to a better future.

The report proposes immediate emotional and academic interventions, as well as proactive and sustainable solutions through the “Hope Initiative,” intended to sustain education, predict problems, and combine short-term support such as psychological services and temporary learning spaces with long-term educational frameworks.

Residents of San Andrés Hueyapan, Morelos, already severely affected by the September 19 earthquake, are experiencing heightened stress as nearby Popocatépetl shows renewed volcanic activity. Authorities advised people in Tetela del Volcán to keep documents and clothing ready in case of eruption. Locals say they are accustomed to the volcano, known as Don Goyo, but the combination of tremors, ashfall and recent earthquake damage has increased anxiety. Hueyapan, 18 kilometers from the volcano, suffered major home damage. Ashfall was reported in Tetela del Volcán and Zacualpan de Amilpas after recent eruptions.

Sean “Diddy” Combs was sentenced in Manhattan to 50 months in prison and a $500,000 fine after being convicted of two Mann Act prostitution-related counts for transporting sex workers and girlfriends across state lines for “freak offs.” A jury cleared him of more serious sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy charges. Prosecutors sought 11 years, while his defense asked for no more than 14 months. Combs apologized in court, but Judge Arun Subramanian said his good works did not erase abuse of women. Combs still faces numerous civil lawsuits alleging sexual assault and other violence, which he denies.

The Second Circuit affirmed Samuel Israel III’s conviction and twenty-year sentence from the Southern District of New York. It held that Judge McMahon did not abuse her discretion by declining to recuse herself, finding no evidence or appearance of partiality. The court also rejected Israel’s challenges to his sentence, including claims based on alleged bias, medical needs, cooperation credit, and sentence length. It concluded the sentence was within the range of permissible decisions given his criminal history and the amount of money involved.

DAX 40 and Euro Stoxx 50 futures expire quarterly on the third Friday of March, June, September, and December. Backtests show both perform better during futures expiration week than random weeks: DAX 40 averages +0.39% with a 57% win ratio, while Euro Stoxx 50 averages +0.3% with a 54% win ratio. December is the strongest month for both, while June is weak for Euro Stoxx 50. For DAX 40 after expiration, the test uses 100% margin, not futures backtesting, buying at expiration Friday’s close and selling one week later. This averages -0.1% with a 47% win ratio, with September especially poor.
The UC1825BEVM-CVAL uses an RCD clamp to limit switch node overshoot, with starting resistor and capacitor values based on allowable overshoot and parasitic inductance.

The Supreme Court reversed the Eighth Circuit and remanded. Brooks, a railroad apprentice machinist, left for military service, returned, later completed his apprenticeship in North Little Rock, and was assigned seniority from January 23, 1958. He sought seniority from November 3, 1955, arguing he would have completed his apprenticeship then but for military service. The District Court found promotion from apprentice to mechanic was automatic in practice and that Brooks would have become a journeyman at North Little Rock on that date. The Court held, following Tilton v. Missouri Pacific Railroad Co., that speculative possibilities about future job availability could not defeat veterans’ seniority rights, and concluded Brooks was entitled to seniority as of November 3, 1955, at North Little Rock.

The passage outlines design guidance for a PGA848 front end driving an ADS8860 ADC with ±15V supplies and a 5V reference. It describes three filters for EMI/RFI reduction, PGA feedback bandwidth control, and SAR ADC charge kickback settling, noting nominal 318kHz bandwidth and 41kHz –0.1dB flatness. The PGA848 REF pin is set to 2.5V using a REF6250 divider and OPA192 buffer, with stability requirements for bypass capacitance changes. Power guidance specifies nominal ±15V operation and warns that supply voltages above 40V damage the device. Layout recommendations emphasize matched input paths, close bypass capacitors, separation from noisy traces, minimized leakage, parasitics, vias, and thermal gradients. The passage also lists TI simulation tools, related documentation, support resources, trademarks, ESD handling precautions, revision and ordering information, and TI warranty and liability disclaimers.

The disclosure concerns elastomeric compositions, particularly silicone-based compositions, containing dispersed carbon black particles, and methods for preparing them. The methods use hydrophilic, often oxidized, carbon black particles treated with silicone-compatible dispersants having carbon-black-affinic moieties, such as amino, acrylate, or epoxy groups. The treated particles are mixed with curable hydrophobic silicone pre-polymers and then addition-cured or condensation-cured to form elastomeric compositions with dispersed carbon black.

The dispersants may be siloxane-containing or silicone-based, including amino-silicone, silicone-acrylate, or silicone-epoxy dispersants, and are selected to be miscible with the silicone matrix while associating with hydrophilic carbon black surfaces. Size reduction may be performed in the presence of the dispersant to produce treated particles with Dv90 values commonly in the low-micron or submicron range.

The hydrophilic carbon black may be characterized by acidic pH, volatile matter content, oxygen-containing surface groups, acid value, negative zeta potential, water dispersibility, and Raman spectroscopy ratios indicating defective or oxidized carbon structure. The resulting cured compositions may contain catalysts such as platinum or tin and functional groups detectable by FTIR.

The disclosure also describes articles containing these cured compositions and potential uses in industrial fields, including intermediate transfer members for indirect printing, sealants, and applications benefiting from carbon black’s mechanical, thermal, electrical, radiation-absorbing, or pigment properties. Definitions and measurement methods are provided for terms including miscibility, readily dispersed carbon black, siloxane-based dispersants, volatile solvents, particle size, and cured compositions.

Americans spent over $100 billion on summer vacations last year, and travel may reduce stress and improve health, but it can be expensive. Suggested ways to save include setting a budget, using travel deal websites, avoiding foreign transaction and roaming fees, traveling offseason, booking early, considering trip insurance, watching airline newsletters for limited-time deals, and finding local coupons or discount passes.

U.S. equities rose Monday, led by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, as gains in technology and semiconductor shares offset weakness in energy stocks. Investors remained cautious about a possible government shutdown, which could delay key economic data, including the jobs report, and complicate Federal Reserve decision-making. Despite hawkish comments from Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, markets continued to expect a modest rate cut. The passage also lists global financial and business headlines covering payments, bonds, tariffs, technology regulation, infrastructure, markets, and corporate deals, and describes Pan Finance as a global financial intelligence publisher with a readership across 150 countries.

Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko appeared alive at a Kiev news conference less than 24 hours after Ukrainian police reported he had been shot dead. He and Ukrainian security officials said the killing was staged to thwart an alleged Kremlin-backed plot against him. Babchenko apologized to his wife, friends and family, saying they had not been told in advance. Ukrainian Security Service chief Vasyl Gritsak said investigators identified and detained a Ukrainian man allegedly paid $40,000 by Russian security services to organize the killing, and claimed the plot was part of a broader plan involving weapons, explosives and terrorist attacks in Ukraine. Babchenko said authorities had known of a contract on his life for two months and that his life and other attacks had been prevented.

The ARM Cortex-A8 MPU Subsystem gives the Cortex-A8 master control for configuring and controlling device subsystems, peripherals, and external memories. It includes ARMv7 ISA with Thumb2, JazelleX, Media Extensions, and AINTC. The subsystem integrates a Cortex-A8 processor with debug support, Harvard architecture, NEON SIMD, VFPv3, L1 instruction/data caches, 128-bit interconnect, and ETM trace support connected to a 32KB ETB.

Miami-Dade Mayor Carlos Gimenez announced a study finding PortMiami is the top money-making operation in the county and state, with an economic impact exceeding $41 billion. In 2016, the port contributed about $288 million in taxes, supported 300,000 direct and indirect jobs, handled 8.9 million tons of cargo, and reached a record 5.1 million cruise passengers. The Miami Herald questioned whether the study inflated figures, but Gimenez defended them. A planned Royal Caribbean terminal is expected to add $500 million annually.

National Weather Service San Diego issued a July 4, 2018 zone forecast for extreme southwestern California. High surf advisories were in effect for Orange County and San Diego coastal areas from Wednesday evening through Friday night, and excessive heat watches were in effect across listed zones from Friday morning through Saturday evening. Conditions were generally mostly sunny to partly cloudy, with morning low clouds and fog near coastal and valley areas. Temperatures were expected to rise sharply Friday and remain very hot Saturday, with inland valleys, mountains, passes, and deserts reaching widespread triple digits, including 110–117 degrees in some desert and Inland Empire areas. Slight chances of showers and thunderstorms were forecast mainly for mountain and some desert areas from Saturday through Tuesday.

The Blue Ridge Poison Control Center warns that spring brings increased risks from poisonous plants and mushrooms, black widow spiders, and snakes. It advises against self-treating natural toxin exposures and recommends wearing proper clothing, checking boots, and staying aware outdoors.

James Madison, responding to a congressional request, recommended the third Thursday in August 1812 as a day of public humiliation and prayer during wartime, calling for repentance, divine protection and guidance, national unity, justice among nations, and a restoration of peace.

The passage argues that IEX has split into two identities: “IEX One,” a niche exchange using a speed bump to improve execution for buy-side traders within the SEC’s national market system, and “IEX Two,” a would-be market disruptor seeking to serve all traders and dominate the market. The author says IEX’s market share remains under 3% because its speed bump is only another NMS-based cost/subsidy mechanism, not a true disruption. To achieve broader success, the passage argues, IEX must bypass or confront the SEC’s national market system, stop favoring one trader group over another, and deliver liquidity that attracts brokers and traders.

The U.S. economy added 200,000 jobs in January while unemployment stayed at 4.1 percent. Average hourly wages rose 2.9 percent from a year earlier, suggesting possible acceleration in pay growth amid a tightening labor market. Some economists attributed the wage increase partly to January minimum wage hikes in 18 states affecting 4.5 million workers. Analysts cautioned against drawing broad conclusions from one report, noting revisions and margins of error. Job growth under President Trump has been similar to the previous year under Obama, with 2.1 million jobs added in 2017 versus 2.2 million in 2016. African-American unemployment rose to 7.7 percent in January after falling to 6.8 percent in December, while broader declines in unemployment predated Trump’s presidency. Federal job estimates are revised as more payroll data becomes available, while unemployment is calculated through a separate household survey.
IT Central Station compares Oracle Exadata and HPE Vertica user reviews, highlighting Exadata’s smart scan, Vertica’s columnar storage, and reported needs for improved patching and documentation.

The passage praises Coronation Street’s sensitive handling of Aidan’s suicide storyline and says it has renewed discussion about suicide. The writer shares having once attempted suicide as a teenager while struggling with sexuality, then recounts friend Cheryl Fialka’s experience after her husband John died by suicide 33 years ago. Cheryl describes the shock of receiving the news, the lack of warning signs or note, and the lasting grief, confusion, and anger caused by his death. The writer notes Cheryl still suffers deeply and reflects on the devastation suicide leaves behind.

ESPN rose through the cable bundle by combining affiliate fees and advertising, becoming a major profit driver for Disney. By 2024, its position was under pressure from declining cable and satellite subscribers, rising live sports rights costs, changing consumer behavior, and competition from streaming and technology companies.

The company’s history included rapid expansion from its 1979 launch, evolving ownership under Getty, ABC, Capital Cities, Disney, and Hearst, and major growth driven by affiliate fees, NFL rights, direct broadcast satellite competition, and new ESPN-branded channels. Live sports rights became central to ESPN’s value, while SportsCenter and other news programming supported its brand and audience engagement.

The Internet weakened ESPN’s dominance in sports news and information by lowering barriers to entry for blogs, podcasts, social media, and niche sports coverage. ESPN responded with digital products including ESPN.com, ESPN3, mobile apps, WatchESPN, and ESPN+, launched in 2018 after Disney acquired BAMTech. ESPN+ grew to about 25 million subscribers but initially served as a supplemental service rather than a replacement for ESPN’s linear networks.

Disney later confirmed that ESPN’s flagship network would become available direct-to-consumer in 2025. In 2024, Disney, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery announced Venu Sports, a joint sports streaming venture combining their sports networks. These moves marked ESPN’s shift from a primarily B2B model built on affiliates and advertisers toward a B2C model focused on customer acquisition, retention, pricing, streaming profitability, and first-party data.

The broader sports media ecosystem was also changing. Incumbent media companies were balancing declining linear television businesses with streaming investments. Technology companies such as Amazon, YouTube, Apple, Netflix, TikTok, Meta, and X pursued sports content for varied strategic reasons. Sports leagues continued to seek reach, revenue, and relevance, while rising rights fees supported team valuations but showed signs of pressure in some markets. Cable and satellite operators increasingly emphasized broadband, with some reducing or exiting video services.

Fans gained more choice in how and where to watch sports, but also faced fragmentation, higher potential costs, discoverability challenges, and piracy. ESPN’s future depended on managing expensive rights obligations, replacing declining affiliate revenue with streaming revenue, maintaining relevance with younger fans, and determining whether it could become a leading digital sports platform while sustaining profitability.

Competitive Capabilities International and R&G Global Consultants partnered to develop Stable Operations TRACC, a data-driven product designed to scale predictable and stable manufacturing operations. CCi says clients can achieve a 15 to 20 percent capacity increase within six months. Cargill was the first client to deploy it and helped facilitate the partnership. The product addresses challenges including capacity utilization, supply chain service delivery and CAPEX avoidance, combining data analytics, TRACC methodology and blended learning. R&G says the integrated product provides a roadmap with maturity stages to support structural productivity and implementation.

The Pakistan Super League will allow franchises to draft replacement players if contracted foreign stars decline to play the March 5 final in Lahore over security concerns. The PCB promised top-level security, while a recent Lahore bombing raised doubts. Najam Sethi said some foreign players are willing to play and others may be replaced. FICA warned players against traveling to Pakistan, but Pakistan’s army chief pledged support.

After her 20-year marriage ended, the author realized she knew little about her family’s accounts, investments, budget, or her own 401(k). With help from a friend, her father’s financial planner, and a new job connection, she gathered documents, built a budget, rebuilt her career, and gained financial confidence. She now handles major decisions herself and plans for retirement on her own terms.

The passage examines challenges to women’s education in rural Pakistan and Azad Jammu and Kashmir. It cites low female literacy, especially in rural areas, and identifies barriers including poverty, patriarchal culture, lack of motivation, illiterate family environments, early marriages, limited schools, transport problems, religious restrictions, and weak infrastructure. The study used a quantitative survey-based approach with separate open-ended questionnaires for illiterate and literate women.

Findings show that both groups viewed women’s education as necessary but faced similar obstacles. Key problems included heavy household work, lack of resources, family pressure, gender discrimination, low parental education, financial hardship, limited secondary and higher secondary institutions, lack of transport, poor school facilities, technical issues, outdated curriculum, language barriers, subject restrictions, and insufficient teacher training. The discussion links these factors to reduced access, continuation, and confidence in education.

The conclusion states that women’s education remains a major challenge despite government efforts. Suggested measures include monthly seminars on women’s education, use of media and social media for awareness, involvement of parents and women in discussions, legislation for compulsory women’s education, and expanded open and distance education.

Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke is visiting Maine to review the Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument. The author describes Maine’s inland wilderness as central to the state’s identity and argues the monument, created from a private donation of over 87,000 acres and supported by a $40 million endowment, offers preservation and economic benefits for rural Maine. The passage criticizes Gov. Paul LePage’s opposition to the designation and expresses hope that Zinke will recognize the monument’s cultural and economic value.

The CAG 2015/16 report identified weaknesses in public procurement, including non-compliance, poor contract and project management, irregular procurements without competitive quotations, project delays, purchases without tender board approval, and procurements without valid contracts. It cited cases involving the Ministry of Water and Irrigation and Registrar of Political Parties. The report also found poor asset management across MDAs, including dilapidated embassy buildings, undeveloped embassy plots, and lack of adequate action to maintain government properties abroad.

The passage describes portions of a Texas Instruments device data manual covering memory mapping, device pins, boot configuration, pin multiplexing, and pullup/pulldown guidance. Some Cortex-A8 memory regions are internally decoded and reserved for other masters. The DDR DMM TILER provides an additional 4 GB extended addressing range using a 33rd address bit for rotated and mirrored frame-buffer views, fully accessible only to HDVPSS and ISS.

Terminal function tables identify signal names, pin multiplexing, ball numbers, pin types, internal pull states, supply sources, and functions for interfaces including boot configuration, camera, CAN, DDR2/DDR3, EMAC, GPIO, GPMC, HDMI, I2C, McASP, PCIe, reset/JTAG, SD, SPI, clocks, timers, UART, USB, video input/output, analog TV output, reserved pins, and supply voltages.

Boot behavior is determined by sampling BTMODE[15:0] at reset deassertion and latching values into CONTROL_STATUS. BTMODE fields configure GPMC settings, boot mode order, Ethernet PHY mode, XIP GPMC muxing options, and PCIe addressing options. Device pin multiplexing is controlled through PINCNTL1–PINCNTL270 MUXMODE bits; most pins default to tri-state, and some functions are multimuxed.

Unused signal pins may generally be left unconnected unless specified, but unused inputs should use internal or external pull resistors to avoid floating. Boot configuration pins routed out and tri-stated should use external pullup or pulldown resistors. Supply pins must be connected to the required voltages even when associated functions are unused.

The LifeCLEF 2014 plant identification task extended previous ImageCLEF efforts to evaluate content-based plant identification under realistic conditions. The PlantCLEF 2014 dataset contained 60,962 images from 19,504 observations of 500 European plant species, contributed by 1,608 users, with seven view types: entire plant, fruit, leaf, flower, stem, branch, and leaf scan. Each image included metadata such as observation ID, taxon information, date, location, author, and user quality ratings, though test metadata excluded ground truth and ratings.

The task evaluated species retrieval from multi-image plant observation queries, where each query could include several images of the same individual plant. The dataset was split into 47,816 training images and 13,146 test images. Scoring was based on the inverse rank of the correct species, averaged per author to reduce contributor bias. A secondary image-level metric was also used.

Seventy-four groups registered, and 10 submitted runs. Methods included Fisher vectors, bag-of-visual-words, convolutional neural networks, global descriptors, matching approaches, and metadata-based methods. IBM AU achieved the best results, led by a Fisher Vector, CNN, and segmentation combination with a score of 0.471. PlantNet followed with matching-based methods around 0.289. CNN-only approaches performed less strongly, likely due to limited training data and restrictions on external training data. Combining multiple images from the same observation generally improved performance. LeafScan and Flower images produced the best organ-level results. The paper concludes that results are encouraging, but scaling plant recognition to thousands of species remains difficult, with a possible future task covering all French flora estimated at about 5,000 species.

Offensive switches in soccer are exchanges of positions between two attacking teammates used to beat defenders. They may be called verbally or occur naturally during play, and may be done with or without the ball. In a basic switch, two players run diagonally in an “X” pattern and temporarily assume each other’s roles. The objective is to free one or both runners for a pass by forcing defenders to choose marks or causing confusion. Switches are usually used in the opponents’ half. Horizontal or lateral switches involve side-to-side exchanges toward opposite touchlines, while vertical switches involve front-to-back exchanges toward opposite end-lines. Vertical switches are distinct from overlapping runs because they require an actual exchange of positions. After a switch, players should verbally acknowledge returning to their original positions when it can be done without compromising play.

MatterMech is introduced as a benchmark for evaluating large language models’ ability to hypothesize physicochemical principles in nanomaterial synthesis. It contains 4,800 questions across eight subdomains: biological, carbon, ceramic, compositional, metal, photocatalytic/energy, polymer, and semiconductor nanomaterials. The benchmark was built from about 17,000 academic papers using Claude-3.5-Sonnet, multi-agent roundtable validation to reduce hallucinations, MCQ-to-text-infilling transformation, and human quality evaluation. MatterDB is also released, containing 31,735 papers paired with LLM-extracted synthesis mechanisms and academic sources.

Fourteen LLMs were evaluated using multiple-choice accuracy and text-infilling similarity. Qwen-Max achieved the highest average MCQ accuracy, while Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct led text-infilling performance. Results show that models perform better on logical reasoning in MCQs than on precise terminology completion in TIF tasks. Reasoning-focused models performed competitively on MCQs but weaker on TIFs, suggesting a gap between inference and factual recall. Larger models generally performed better, following a logarithmic scaling trend.

Multi-agent validation improved semantic alignment with source documents, and human evaluation found the generated MCQs to be high quality. Principle-guided prompting improved MCQ accuracy and reduced output token length compared with automatic Chain-of-Thought prompting. The study identifies limitations in current LLMs’ ability to integrate materials concepts with principle-based reasoning and suggests future work on test-time inference, self-reflection, multi-agent systems, and synthesis-focused hypothesis generation frameworks.

The study examined difficulties in university foreign language education after the Covid-19 shift from face-to-face to distance education. The sample included 294 undergraduate and graduate students studying German or English in 2020–2021. Data were collected online using a questionnaire and a 53-item distance education problems scale with six subscales.

Students reported that distance education was not successful for foreign language teaching. The main problems were internet and computer issues, especially connection interruptions and poor internet quality, followed by student-related problems such as lack of motivation and low participation. Course-content problems included insufficient mutual communication, while measurement and evaluation problems included difficulty measuring skill-based gains. Teacher-related and software-related problems were reported at lower levels.

Male students perceived student-related problems more than female students. Problems did not differ by whether students studied German or English. Students without training in distance education programs, without an independent study room, or without home internet reported more problems. The study recommends training students and teachers in distance education tools, methods, assessment, communication, virtual classroom management, and designing foreign language education as a hybrid model.

The lecture discusses quantization of the Dirac theory using anticommutation relations instead of commutators. This avoids an unbounded Hamiltonian and gives fermionic statistics, with creation operators that obey the Pauli principle. Expanding the Dirac field into modes leads to particle and antiparticle operators, positive energy, single-particle momentum eigenstates, and spin-1/2 excitations.

The conserved U(1) Noether charge distinguishes particles and antiparticles: they have the same mass and spin but opposite charge. Applied to electrons, the theory predicts a positron with the same mass and opposite electric charge, later observed in cosmic rays.

The lecture also introduces Dirac-field correlation functions, including Wightman, retarded, and Feynman functions, showing their relation to scalar correlators through the operator \(i\partial\!\!\!/ + m\). The momentum-space fermion propagator is written as the inverse of the Dirac operator. The lecture ends by motivating chiral and Majorana fermions as reductions of the Dirac spinor.

The study examined whether a mitochondrial polygenic score (MGS) and lifestyle or environmental factors influence age at onset in LRRK2-associated Parkinson’s disease (LRRK2-PD) and idiopathic Parkinson’s disease (iPD). It analyzed 9,745 patients from AMP-PD, Fox Insight, and a Tunisian Arab-Berber cohort, including 486 with LRRK2-PD and 9,259 with iPD. A higher MGS was associated with earlier age at onset in LRRK2-PD, particularly among patients of European/White ancestry, but not in unstratified iPD. Lifestyle analyses found interactions between MGS and coffee or caffeinated soda consumption in LRRK2-PD, and between MGS and caffeinated soda consumption or workplace pesticide exposure in iPD. Patients with higher MGS and these exposures generally had earlier onset. The authors conclude that mitochondrial genetic burden interacts with lifestyle and environmental factors in Parkinson’s disease and may modify age at onset.

The passage describes ADS868xW data transfer, command, output, protocol, register, application, power, and layout information. A data transfer frame starts when CONVST/CS falls and ends when it rises, initiating conversion. During the frame, SCLK shifts SDI data into the input shift register and shifts output data from the output shift register to SDO pins. A 32-clock frame is optimal and produces a valid 32-bit command; fewer than 32 clocks create a short frame treated as NOP for writes but still valid for output data; more than 32 clocks create a long frame where the last 32 input bits form the command.

Device programming uses 32-bit input command words synchronized to SCLK. Supported operations include read, half-word read/write, byte write, set, and clear commands. For half-word commands, the LSB of the 9-bit address is ignored. Output data in frame F+1 depends on the command in frame F and DATA_VAL settings: fixed patterns, register data, or the latest 16-bit conversion result. Optional appended flags include device address, input range, AVDD alarm, input alarm, and parity.

The multiSPI interface supports legacy SPI-compatible protocols for writing and reading, single or dual SDO output, and source-synchronous read protocols using RVS as an output clock. On power-up or reset, SPI-00-S is used until configuration changes the protocol. Dual SDO mode uses SDO-0 and SDO-1 and requires half as many clock cycles to output the same number of bits.

Nine configuration registers control device ID, reset and power, SDI and SDO protocols, output data, input range, alarms, and alarm thresholds. Application information describes the ADS868xW as a fully differential 16-bit SAR ADC-based data acquisition device with integrated AFE, programmable gain amplifier, ADC driver, reference, overvoltage protection, input alarm, and AVDD alarm. An example industrial analog input module combines ADS8681W with an eight-channel MUX36D08 for voltage, current, or temperature sensing.

The passage describes a patent disclosure for systems and methods enabling periodic beam failure measurements in digital wireless communications, particularly 5G NR systems using high-frequency beamforming. A user equipment (UE) determines measurement period durations based on periodic beam failure detection reference signals (BFD RSs) that are used to assess radio link quality, especially those quasi co-located with demodulation reference signals of monitored control channel receptions. During each measurement period, the UE monitors relevant BFD RSs and reports a beam failure instance when all monitored signals fail to meet a specified threshold, such as signal quality or BLER. A higher layer may declare beam failure after a specified number of consecutive beam failure instances, identify a candidate beam, and send a beam failure recovery request. The disclosure also addresses handling measurement periods with no transmitted BFD RS, including ignoring such periods or treating them as beam failure instances to avoid incorrect counter resets.

The passage introduces MOTO, a multi-objective three-layer optimization framework for mapping local transition-state networks around a given minimum on differentiable potential energy surfaces. MOTO combines: a multi-objective explorer that generates diverse, feasible initial perturbations; a bilayer minimum-mode-following kernel using Hessian-vector products with Lanczos or LOBPCG to locate index-1 saddles; and deterministic bidirectional minimum-mode descent to certify saddle connectivity.

Benchmarks on atomistic spin systems show that Hessian-vector-product methods match explicit-Hessian accuracy while greatly reducing memory and runtime. For a 70×70 spin system, the method reduces incremental peak memory to about 0.01% of the explicit-Hessian approach and gives a tenfold speedup. The implementation scales to 10⁶ spins while computing the two lowest curvature modes with under 1 GB incremental memory and 0.5 s wall time.

MOTO is applied to a DFT-parameterized Pd/Fe/Ir(111) spin model at 2.7 T, mapping local transition-state networks around a Néel skyrmion and an antiskyrmion. It identifies twelve index-1 saddles and up to 32 transition channels, including meron- and antimeron-mediated routes to chiral droplets, bi-antiskyrmions, and two-skyrmion states. Bidirectional descents confirm connectivity and reveal mechanisms for duplication, annihilation, and droplet formation.

The framework is also applied to a Ni heptamer on Ni(111), using Cartesian degrees of freedom and an EAM potential. It maps a dense local transition-state network and recovers low-barrier edge, corner, and concerted rearrangement motifs. The authors conclude that MOTO transfers across spin and Cartesian systems without changing its algorithmic core, while noting limitations related to mask design, objective choice, kernel hyperparameters, and near-degenerate curvature modes.

The study investigates EFL pre-service teachers’ and teacher educators’ perceptions of ICT and CALL integration in a Vietnamese tertiary initial teacher education program. Using Hong’s CALL integration model, it employed a convergent mixed-methods design with surveys, a focus group interview, and individual interviews involving 67 final-year EFL pre-service teachers and three teacher educators at a university in southern Vietnam.

Findings show that pre-service teachers perceived a high level of opportunity to learn CALL-related knowledge, especially ICT pedagogies, online material searching, resource downloading, worksheet creation, and lesson design using digital resources. They reported fewer opportunities to learn troubleshooting, selecting online exercises for individual needs, supervising online work, and using classroom digital equipment for language learning. ICT was mainly used for resource discovery, lesson archiving, information exchange, and developing pedagogical materials.

Teacher educators reported frequent ICT use but identified several barriers: limited educator confidence and skills, fear of change, unstable internet access, outdated or unreliable equipment, slow technical support, pre-service teachers’ limited engagement, and the absence of official institutional policies or guidelines for ICT and CALL integration. The study concludes that opportunities to learn CALL-related knowledge, institutional infrastructure, educator development, learner factors, and clear policies are interdependent components of effective ICT integration. It notes limitations including a small participant group, one research site, and no examination of educator assessment practices or curriculum effects.

Senator William Flinn died in 1924, leaving a widow and six children. His will created annuities, allowed executors five years to administer the estate, distributed part of the residue outright, and placed the remainder in trusts for certain children. The dispute concerned whether life tenants or remaindermen were entitled to undistributed earnings reflected in stock proceeds, and when the “intact value” of the trust assets should be fixed.

The court held that intact value generally is fixed at the testator’s death unless the will clearly provides otherwise. Flinn’s will did not postpone creation of the trusts until settlement of the estate or transfer of stock to the trustee, and treating the trust as suspended would allow improper accumulation of income. Therefore, for stock owned directly by Flinn at death, intact value was properly fixed as of the date of death, entitling life tenants to post-death undistributed earnings.

However, stock owned by Booth & Flinn Company, later distributed to the executors as a dividend, could not be treated as owned directly by Flinn despite his large shareholding. The company was a separate entity, so the intact value of that stock should be fixed when the executors received it as a dividend, not at Flinn’s death.

The court also upheld the lower court’s use of average yearly earnings on a daily basis to determine Gulf Oil earnings accrued up to the date of death, noting no better method or challenge to the evidence was offered. The decree was affirmed as modified, with costs charged to the estate.

The article argues that global citizenship education should be broadened in response to increasing international conflict, especially the war in Ukraine and tensions involving China. It claims existing global citizenship education addresses issues such as human rights, environment, poverty, multiculturalism, and civic activism, but gives insufficient guidance on why violent conflicts arise, how states pursue security, and how citizens can influence foreign policy.

The authors propose supplementing global citizenship education with theories of international politics. Realism highlights anarchy, state security, power rivalry, and self-interest. Regionalism explains cooperation through shared economic and political interests, such as the EU, while also showing limits to supranational citizenship. Institutionalism examines how international organisations, treaties, and practices shape cooperation, while acknowledging limits seen in the UN’s inability to resolve the Ukraine war.

The article argues that international cooperation depends on state interests, issue characteristics, and institutional frameworks. It discusses global public goods, coordination problems, and examples of cooperation such as EU integration and Norway-Russia fisheries management. It also stresses that citizens can engage globally not only through NGOs and advocacy, but also by influencing their own country’s foreign policy.

The authors conclude that teaching should include international conflict, security, state power, cooperation, propaganda, history, and foreign policy. They support the values of global citizenship education but argue its agenda should include military and economic security and more realistic avenues for citizen participation.

The study explored using music software as a contemporary teaching strategy in a general music education course at a Caribbean university, where technology had previously been limited mainly to the Canvas LMS. The course trains early childhood and primary pre-service teachers, and the research focused on whether music software could support instruction, comprehension, performance, and motivation.

Using a mixed methods phenomenological approach, the study involved 24 students. Data were collected through a questionnaire and an assignment using Sibelius music notation software. Students were taught over three weeks to compose eight bars of music in 2/4, 3/4, or 4/4 time using specified note values.

Results showed that the software could be integrated into the course. Most students completed the assignment successfully, with overall 90% accuracy, though four did not submit. Questionnaire responses indicated that many students felt the software enhanced understanding, though many still preferred traditional approaches and reported only moderate comfort. Motivation responses were mostly neutral, but 67% supported continued use of technology in the course, and 75% wanted further training.

The study concluded that music software is relatively easy to integrate and can positively affect student outcomes in music education. Recommendations included continued use of selected music software, ongoing training, inclusion of technology in practicum assessment, and final assessments that evaluate students’ knowledge and use of technology in music teaching.

JWST has made its first confirmed detection of a supernova progenitor star, identifying the source of Type II supernova SN2025pht in spiral galaxy NGC 1637, about 40 million light-years away. A Northwestern-led team combined JWST infrared data with Hubble observations to show the explosion came from a massive red supergiant obscured by unusually dense dust. The star was about 100,000 times more luminous than the Sun but appeared over 100 times dimmer in visible light because of the dust, making it the reddest and dustiest red supergiant progenitor observed. The findings support the idea that many red supergiants do explode as supernovae but are hidden by dust, helping explain why they are rarely observed before exploding. The dust also appeared carbon-rich, which was unexpected for such a star. The team is now searching for similar red supergiants, with future Roman Space Telescope observations expected to help.

The passage introduces the “Simplified Egg and Changing Yolk Model” to explain ventricular repolarisation and T-wave formation on ECGs. The model represents the heart as an asymmetric egg-shaped muscle mass with Wilson’s Central Terminal at its centre. Repolarisation expands outward like a changing yolk, and ECG deflections depend on whether signal components move toward or away from a lead. The model identifies an asymmetric “T-zone” as responsible for generating the T-wave.

It explains normal repolarisation as initially balanced during the ST segment, followed by a deflection when the signal enters the T-zone, peaking at its boundary and returning to baseline as the signal exits. The authors propose the QTp interval, from Q-wave onset to T-wave peak, as more clearly defined and reliably calculable than the QTc interval, which ends when the signal exits the T-zone.

The model is also used to reproduce ST depression, ST elevation, and abnormal T-wave morphologies such as higher, flattened, inverted, and biphasic T-waves by varying damage location, severity, hypertrophy, and lead orientation. The authors argue that repolarisation begins with the Q-wave and that ST and T-wave intervals should be considered one unified process. They also state that QTc measurement has limitations and recommend QTp as a more reliable parameter, especially for arrhythmia risk and medication effects on the QT interval.

The study concludes that the model may improve ECG interpretation, support patient management, and guide future research, including exploration of the U-wave, atrial repolarisation, and coronary artery distribution effects.
